# Digital Marketing Senior Specialist

$74k - $111k

Full-time

COX ENTERPRISES

[Kansas](https://jooble.org/jobs/Kansas)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-5612531342768880588?p=1&pos=0&rgn=17&pageType=7&jobAge=186&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-6830464427650150729&crId=US_0US_0)

**Company** Cox Automotive - USA

**Job Family Group**

Marketing

**Job Profile**

Digital Marketing / Communications Sr Specialist

**Management Level**

Individual Contributor

**Flexible Work Option**

Can work remotely but need to live in the specified city, state, or region

**Travel %**

Yes, 5% of the time

**Work Shift**

Day

**Compensation**

Compensation includes a base salary in the range of $74,000.00 - $111,000.00. The base salary may vary within the anticipated base pay range based on factors such as the ultimate location of the position and the selected candidate’s knowledge, skills, and abilities. Position may be eligible for additional compensation that may include an incentive program.

**Job Description**

_**\*This position is remote/work from home. You need to reside within the Eastern or Central Time Zones. If near our Atlanta office, the role will be hybrid.**_

The **Senior Specialist, Digital Marketing / Communications – Email, SMS & Organic Social** conducts day-to-day channel operations for email marketing, SMS communications, and organic social media across Cox Automotive’s enterprise B2B portfolio. This role independently executes campaigns for a broad range of brands and products, handling end-to-end campaign development including audience strategy, content optimization, journey design, testing, and performance analysis. The Senior Specialist identifies opportunities to improve engagement and deliverability, proactively recommends new strategies and content approaches, and contributes to the innovation roadmap for channel technologies and platforms.

The ideal candidate brings demonstrated expertise in email marketing, SMS, and organic social execution, with the ability to independently run complex, multi-brand campaigns and proactively recommend improvements. This individual partners closely with 82 auction locations and Key Account Marketing teams, creative teams, marketing automation specialists, analytics, agency partners, and fellow digital marketing professionals to translate business objectives into high-performing channel campaigns, and identifies new industry trends and technologies that can strengthen Cox Automotive’s owned channel presence.

**What You’ll Do**

- Email Campaign Execution & Optimization
- Conduct end-to-end email campaign execution for a broad range of brands and products, including audience segmentation, journey design, template development, content optimization, QA, deployment, and post-send analysis.
- Design nurture programs for different audience segments and lifecycle stages, building progressive engagement sequences that drive conversion and retention.
- Implement progressive profiling strategies to enrich contact data over time and improve personalization capabilities across email campaigns.
- Execute re-engagement campaigns for inactive subscribers, testing content approaches, subject lines, and send timing to recover audience attention.
- Proactively recommend new email strategies, content formats, and automation approaches to amplify engagement and drive toward business objectives.
- Implement deliverability monitoring practices including sender reputation tracking, domain health checks, and ISP feedback loop analysis.
- SMS Campaign Execution & Optimization
- Execute SMS campaigns across a broad range of brands, handling message creation, audience targeting, compliance management, and delivery optimization.
- Coordinate SMS and email orchestration to optimize cross-channel messaging sequences, managing timing and frequency to prevent audience fatigue.
- Design trigger-based SMS programs for time-sensitive updates, alerts, and event-driven communications across the customer lifecycle.
- Monitor carrier-level delivery performance, identifying and resolving issues by carrier to maintain high deliverability rates.
- Identify new SMS capabilities and emerging messaging technologies, translating them into actionable test proposals and implementation plans.
- Organic Social Media Execution & Optimization
- Execute organic social media campaigns across platforms such as LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, and other relevant channels for a broad range of brands and products.
- Develop platform-specific content approaches recognizing different audience behaviors, content formats, and algorithmic requirements across LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, and emerging platforms.
- Conduct social listening to monitor brand mentions, sentiment trends, and trending topics, surfacing insights that inform content strategy and messaging.
- Coordinate organic social content calendars with campaign timelines, product launches, and cultural moments, ensuring consistent publishing cadence.
- Proactively report on organic social performance by platform and brand, providing data-driven improvement recommendations on content mix, posting cadence, and engagement tactics.
- Performance Analytics & Cross-Channel Optimization
- Conduct performance monitoring across email, SMS, and organic social channels, tracking deliverability, engagement, conversion, and audience growth metrics.
- Develop and maintain cross-channel performance dashboards offering visibility into trends, audience responsiveness, and campaign effectiveness.
- Execute A/B and multivariate tests across all three channels, documenting results and socializing learnings with the broader team.
- Identify new industry trends and technologies impacting email, SMS, and social channels, and translate them into actionable plans for improving campaign performance.
- Contribute to the innovation roadmap for channel technologies, automation capabilities, and platform features, evaluating new tools for potential adoption.

**What’s in It for You?**

Here’s a sneak peek at the benefits you could experience as a Cox employee:

- A competitive salary and top-notch bonus/incentive plans.
- Exceptional work-life balance, flexible time-off policies and accommodating work schedules.
- Comprehensive healthcare, with multiple options for individuals and families.
- Generous 401(k) retirement plans with company match.
- Professional development and continuing education opportunities.
- Inclusive parental leave policies, plus comprehensive fertility coverage and adoption assistance.
- Extra perks like pet insurance, employee discounts and much more.

**Who You Are**

**Minimum:**

- Bachelor’s degree in related discipline and 4 years’ experience in a related field. The right candidate could also have a different combination, such as a master’s degree and 2 years’ experience; a Ph.D. and up to 1 year of experience; or 8 years’ experience in a related field.

- Experience in digital marketing with a demonstrated focus on email marketing, SMS, and/or social media execution across multiple brands or platforms.
- Proven track record of independently executing complex, multi-brand campaigns with measurable engagement and performance improvements.
- Strong proficiency with Salesforce Marketing Cloud, including campaign setup, journey building, audience segmentation, automation, and deliverability management.
- Demonstrated expertise with social media management tools and platforms (LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram) including content scheduling, community monitoring, and social listening.
- Working knowledge of SMS campaign execution including compliance frameworks (TCPA, carrier guidelines), opt-in management, and delivery optimization.
- Proficiency with HTML and CSS for email template development and troubleshooting.
- Experience with analytics and reporting tools for measuring email, SMS, and social performance; ability to build dashboards and generate actionable insights.
- Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint) and project management tools such as Monday.com.
- Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret cross-channel performance data, identify trends, and formulate optimization strategies.
- Excellent written communication skills, including the ability to craft and refine channel content and present performance findings to stakeholders.
- Proven project management skills with close attention to detail and the ability to manage competing priorities under minimal guidance.
- Proactive, self-directed approach with the ability to identify opportunities and recommend new strategies without being prompted.
- Collaborative mindset with the ability to work effectively across cross-functional teams, agencies, and brand stakeholders.
- **Travel** : 5%

_**Join the Cox family of businesses and make your mark today!**_

**Drug Testing**

To be employed in this role, you’ll need to clear a pre-employment drug test. Cox Automotive does not currently administer a pre-employment drug test for marijuana for this position. However, we are a drug-free workplace, so the possession, use or being under the influence of drugs illegal under federal or state law during work hours, on company property and/or in company vehicles is prohibited.

**Benefits**

The Company offers eligible employees the flexibility to take as much vacation with pay as they deem consistent with their duties, the company’s needs, and its obligations; seven paid holidays throughout the calendar year; and up to 160 hours of paid wellness annually for their own wellness or that of family members. Employees are also eligible for additional paid time off in the form of bereavement leave, time off to vote, jury duty leave, volunteer time off, military leave, and parental leave.

**About Us**

Through groundbreaking technology and a commitment to stellar experiences for drivers and dealers alike, Cox Automotive employees are transforming the way the world buys, owns, sells – or simply uses – cars. Cox Automotive employees get to work on iconic consumer brands like Autotrader and Kelley Blue Book and industry-leading dealer-facing companies like vAuto and Manheim, all while enjoying the people-centered atmosphere that is central to our life at Cox. # Senior Paid Search Manager

$80k - $100k

Full-time

Lockhern Digital

[United States](https://jooble.org/jobs/United-States)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-2875638219746750380?p=1&pos=0&rgn=0&pageType=7&jobAge=114&jdpSource=101&jdpid=8019325943082220295&crId=US_0US_0)

About the Role

Lockhern Digital is hiring a Senior Paid Search Manager to work directly alongside agency leadership on a growing portfolio of ecommerce client accounts.

This role sits close to the top. Agency leadership sets the strategic direction and owns client onboarding. You'll help shape that strategy account by account, then own the execution and the day-to-day relationship that follows it.

In practice: you're in the strategy conversations, not receiving the output of them. You're on the client calls. You're the person the client hears from about what's working, what isn't, and what's happening next. You're in the platform every day making it happen.

Early on, the weight is on execution while you get acclimated to our clients and how we operate. Over time, you take on more of the day-to-day ownership and more of the strategic lead. How fast that happens depends on you.

About Lockhern Digital

Lockhern Digital is a performance marketing agency specializing in paid search, feed-driven ecommerce, paid social, and SEO/AI search. We run Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, Meta, and YouTube/Demand Gen for a portfolio of ecommerce and lead-generation clients, and we build our own internal tooling to manage accounts efficiently at scale.

We're small, fast-moving, and direct. Practical strategy, clean execution, measurable results.

Key Responsibilities

**Strategy and Planning**

- Partner with agency leadership to develop account strategy for new and existing clients
- Contribute to strategic conversations and planning sessions — bring a point of view, not just notes
- Translate agreed strategy into concrete campaign plans, build specs, and testing roadmaps
- Bring performance findings back into strategy so plans adjust to what the data is actually showing

**Client Management**

- Serve as the primary day-to-day point of contact for assigned accounts
- Lead recurring performance and reporting calls, and participate in strategy calls alongside leadership
- Communicate results, optimizations, and next steps clearly to both clients and internal teams
- Own the account narrative — clients should hear about issues from you before they find them

**Campaign Execution**

- Build, restructure, and launch campaigns across Search, Shopping, Performance Max, Demand Gen, and YouTube
- Manage Google Merchant Center and product feeds, including feed structure, disapprovals, and item-level troubleshooting
- Own budget pacing, bid strategy management, and Smart Bidding oversight
- Maintain conversion tracking accuracy, including enhanced and offline conversions
- Use Google Ads Editor to implement large-scale changes efficiently and accurately

**Optimization and Insight**

- Run ongoing optimization across the portfolio: keyword research, search term analysis, audience refinement, ad copy testing
- Identify performance risks and opportunities and bring them forward with a recommended course of action
- Execute testing plans, document results, and connect outcomes back to business objectives
- Use scripts, GAQL, Google Sheets, and LLM-assisted workflows to monitor and optimize accounts at scale

**Reporting**

- Build and maintain reports and dashboards in Looker Studio, GA4, and Google Ads
- Deliver recurring performance summaries focused on business outcomes rather than platform metrics
- Give internal teams the context they need to speak to account performance

**Collaboration**

- Work alongside paid social, SEO, landing page, and client strategy teams
- Document account knowledge and process to support the team as the portfolio grows

Required Qualifications

- Deep, current hands-on experience managing Google Ads at a senior level across multiple client accounts simultaneously
- **Ecommerce depth is required.** Google Merchant Center, product feed structure and troubleshooting, Shopping and Performance Max architecture, feed-driven strategy
- Advanced working knowledge of Search, Shopping, Performance Max, Demand Gen, YouTube, and conversion tracking
- Fluent in Google Ads Editor for large-scale builds and restructures
- Demonstrated use of automation in your workflow — Google Ads scripts, GAQL, Sheets/Apps Script, LLM-assisted analysis, or similar
- Reporting and analysis in GA4 and Looker Studio
- Client-facing experience — you've run the call, not just prepared the deck for it
- Strong written and verbal communication, and the judgment to know when to raise something
- Agency experience strongly preferred

Preferred Experience

- Microsoft Ads
- Meta and paid social
- Lead-generation accounts alongside ecommerce
- Landing page and CRO collaboration
- Experience mentoring junior account staff

What Success Looks Like

**First 30–60 days:** You've absorbed the accounts and our approach, you're executing accurately and on time, and you're contributing in strategy conversations rather than just listening.

**By 90 days:** You're running reporting calls independently. Clients know you and trust you. Performance issues get surfaced by you, with a recommendation attached.

**Beyond:** You're carrying more of the day-to-day ownership and taking a larger strategic lead on your accounts.

Who This Is For

Someone who wants to work closely with leadership rather than at a distance from it. Someone who takes a direction and runs, then comes back with results and a point of view. Someone who reaches for a script or a query before a manual export.

If you want a defined process handed to you, this isn't the right fit. If you've been the most capable person on an account team and want the ownership and the seat at the table to match, it is.

Compensation and Benefits

- Annual salary of $80,000–$100,000
- Remote work environment
- 401(k) with company match
- Company-subsidized health insurance

Full-time

Weiss Ratings

[Palm Beach Gardens, FL](https://jooble.org/jobs/Palm-Beach-Gardens%2C-FL)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/6958562070226101559?p=1&pos=0&rgn=9841&pageType=7&jobAge=114&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-5484147743710603488&crId=US_0US_0)

**Job Title: Senior Online Subscription Marketing Manager - Weiss Ratings Plus**

**Location:** Remote

**Company:** Weiss Ratings, LLC

**About Weiss Ratings:** . Our mission is to empower consumers, professionals, and institutions with high-quality, unbiased advisory information to help them invest smarter and safer. We are recognized by the U.S. Government Accountability Office (GAO) and The Wall Street Journal for the accuracy and performance of our ratings.

**About Weiss Ratings Plus:**

Weiss Ratings Plus is our premier, data-powered web subscription service designed for investors who demand real-time, objective financial intelligence. Which provides subscribers with access to:

- America's #1 Stock Rating System, supercharged with premium features.
- Powerful, proprietary data filters and advanced stock screening tools.
- Real-time Buy & Sell alerts based on data-driven algorithms and expert analysis.
- A vast database including ratings on over 50,000 stocks, ETFs, and mutual funds.

**The Opportunity:**

We are seeking a results-oriented and user-focused Product Manager to lead the strategy, development, and growth of our flagship digital subscription platform, Weiss Ratings Plus. This pivotal role will be responsible for defining and executing the product roadmap, with a focus on subscriber acquisition, engagement, and retention. The ideal candidate will drive memberships on our flagship membership of Weiss Ratings Plus.

**Key Responsibilities:**

- **Own, Manage and Create New Product Features:** Define and own the product roadmap for the Weiss Ratings Plus web and app platform, launching new features and tools for subscribers.
- **Subscription Lifecycle Management:** Drive initiatives focused on key subscription metrics, including conversion rates (paywalls, checkout), user onboarding, retention, and churn reduction.
- **Growth & Acquisition** : Drive acquisition and subscription of new members to the platform through multiple traffic strategies.
- **Develop Promotional Funnels** : Work with copywriters, and developers to create and launch promotional landing pages, sales pages and sales carts.
- **Cross-Functional Leadership:** Collaborate with cross-functional Agile teams including engineers, designers, data scientists, and marketing to deliver high-quality products on time.
- **Feature Definition & Execution:** Translate market needs and user insights into clear product requirements and user stories, overseeing the product development process from concept to launch.
- **Data-Driven Decision Making:** Use quantitative and qualitative data to inform decisions, set strategic goals, prioritize features, and continuously iterate the product strategy.
- **Stakeholder Communication:** Effectively communicate product vision, strategy, and performance metrics to all internal stakeholders, including senior management.

**Qualifications:**

- 5+ years of product management experience, with a direct focus on web subscription or direct-to-consumer digital products.
- Solid background in financial products, investment ratings, market analysis, or related financial services industry experience is highly preferred.
- Past ability to acquire new customers and subscriptions thru multiple traffic sources and methods.
- Demonstrated success in driving business outcomes and managing complex digital products through the full product lifecycle.
- Experience with subscription funnel components (paywalls, checkouts, etc.) and familiarity with digital subscription metrics.
- Proficiency in product management tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence), data analytics platforms, and experimentation methodologies.
- Strong analytical, problem-solving, and strategic thinking skills, with meticulous attention to detail.
- Exceptional leadership and communication skills, with proven ability to drive alignment across diverse teams.
- Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Technology, or a related field; relevant certifications (CSPO, PMP) are a plus.
- Experience with direct response copy and marketing a plus.

**Why Join Weiss Ratings?**

- Be part of a company with a proven track record of accuracy, independence, and objectivity.
- Work in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment with exceptional co-workers.
- Make a tangible impact by helping investors navigate the markets with confidence.
- Competitive salary and benefits package.

If you are a motivated product leader with a passion for finance and technology, apply today to help us shape the future of independent financial ratings!

Fractional Demand

[West Virginia](https://jooble.org/jobs/West-Virginia)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/6190178191295898168?p=1&pos=0&rgn=49&pageType=7&jobAge=402&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-4944518408212840770&crId=US_0US_0)

### Job Description

**Fractional Demand** , a B2B Growth Marketing Agency that specializes in turning strategy into high-performing paid media campaigns, is seeking a passionate and data-driven Sr. Performance Marketing Manager to join our growing team.

\\n

\\n

**In This Role, You Will:**

\\n

\\n - Manage 4-7 B2B clients, running their paid media accounts across various platforms, including Google, LinkedIn, Meta, Reddit, X, OpenAI, etc.
\\n - Act as the account manager for the clients you manage
\\n - Develop and execute data-driven paid search and paid social strategies aligned with client goals and industry best practices.
\\n - Manage campaign budgets, optimize performance, and deliver exceptional results that drive lead generation and ROI.
\\n - Conduct in-depth competitor analysis and stay current on paid media trends and platform updates.
\\n - Collaborate with clients’ internal teams (creatives, strategists) to ensure seamless campaign execution.
\\n - Translate client needs into actionable campaign plans, goals, and KPIs.
\\n - Generate insightful reports and recommendations for clients, keeping them informed of campaign performance.
\\n - Go beyond top-of-funnel performance to help the client understand the down-funnel impact of the accounts/campaigns you're managing for them.
\\n

\\n

\\n

**Job Requirements:**

\\n

\\n - 3+ years of experience working in-house at a B2B tech company managing paid media campaigns.
\\n - Proven expertise in paid search (Google Ads) and paid social (LinkedIn, Meta, X Ads, Reddit) advertising.
\\n - A strong understanding of B2B marketing principles, lead generation strategies, and the B2B buyer journey.
\\n - Excellent analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and translate insights into actionable campaign optimizations.
\\n - Exceptional communication and presentation skills to clearly communicate campaign results and recommendations to clients.
\\n - A passion for staying ahead of the curve on the latest paid media trends and platform updates.
\\n - The ability to manage multiple client accounts simultaneously and prioritize tasks effectively.
\\n - A results-oriented mindset with a focus on exceeding client expectations.
\\n

\\n

\\n

**Fractional Demand Offers:**

\\n

\\n - The opportunity to be part of a dynamic and fast-paced agency environment.
\\n - The chance to work with a diverse range of B2B tech clients.
\\n - A competitive salary + agency revenue sharing
\\n - 20 days of PTO your first year (25 days after that)
\\n - The ability to make a significant impact on client growth and success.
\\n

\\n

\\n

**If you're a paid media pro who thrives in a results-oriented environment and is passionate about helping B2B companies achieve their goals, we want to hear from you!**

Why Harvey At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.
This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.
Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.
At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.
Role Overview Harvey is transforming how legal professionals work through AI. We're looking for a Senior Performance Marketing Manager, Paid Social to help unlock the next stage of growth across our paid media programs.
You’ll own and scale paid social as a key driver of pipeline, revenue, and market awareness—reaching legal decision-makers across law firms and corporate legal departments worldwide.
This role sits at the intersection of strategy and execution. You’ll develop audience strategies, launch and optimize full-funnel campaigns, partner closely with creative and content teams, and use data to uncover new growth opportunities. You’ll own the roadmap and end-to-end execution while helping shape how paid social contributes to Harvey's broader growth strategy.
We’re looking for someone who thrives in fast-paced environments, embraces experimentation, and has a track record of turning paid media investments into measurable business outcomes.
What You'll Do Own and Scale Paid Social Growth
Own end-to-end strategy, execution, and optimization of paid social campaigns across LinkedIn, Meta, and emerging social platforms, managing a significant budget to hit aggressive pipeline targets.

Build full-funnel programs that generate awareness, engagement, pipeline, and revenue across enterprise audiences.

Develop audience strategies leveraging first-party data, account-based targeting, lookalike modeling, and platform-native targeting capabilities.

Drive Experimentation and Performance
Design and run experiments across creative, messaging, audiences, landing pages to identify scalable growth opportunities.

Continuously evaluate emerging channels, ad formats, audience targeting and platform capabilities to expand reach and improve efficiency.

Establish testing frameworks and best practices that improve campaign performance over time.

Partner Across the Business
Collaborate closely with lifecycle marketing, content, and brand teams to ensure paid social campaigns are integrated into holistic customer journeys with consistent messaging.

Partner with design teams to develop compelling campaign concepts and provide performance-driven feedback on messaging and creative assets.

Work closely with Marketing Operations and Analytics teams to ensure accurate attribution, measurement, and reporting.

What You Have Bachelor’s degree or higher in Marketing

5–7+ years of experience managing paid social programs in B2B SaaS, with a strong focus on pipeline and revenue generation.

Deep expertise across LinkedIn, Meta, and YouTube advertising platforms.

Proven success scaling paid social programs while improving efficiency and business outcomes.

Strong analytical capabilities with experience using performance data to drive strategic decisions.

Experience building and executing campaigns targeting enterprise buyers with long and complex sales cycles.

Working knowledge of attribution, conversion tracking, CRM integrations, and marketing measurement frameworks.

Ability to operate both strategically and tactically—you can define the roadmap and execute the details.

Excellent communication skills and experience collaborating across marketing, operations, and sales teams.

Preferred Qualifications
Experience managing seven-figure annual media budgets and scaling paid media programs in high-growth B2B SaaS companies.

Experience with CTV, Reddit, programmatic media, or other emerging paid acquisition channels.

Experience marketing to legal, professional services, or other enterprise audiences with complex buying cycles.

# Senior Performance Marketing Manager

Icatalyft

[New York, NY](https://jooble.org/jobs/New-York%2C-NY)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/3320568861209835578?p=1&pos=0&rgn=33025&pageType=7&jobAge=18&jdpSource=101&jdpid=6495676249314835805&crId=US_0US_0)

As Senior Performance Marketing Manager , you will lead performance strategy and media buying across a portfolio of iGaming, online casino and betting brands. You will design and scale multi-channel, multi-market funnels that turn media investment into profitable, high-value players and leads.

Key responsibilities

Own performance strategy and media buying across paid social, search, display, native, programmatic and affiliates for multiple iGaming and casino clients.

Architect full-funnel, multi-touch customer journeys that combine paid, organic, brand and promotional campaigns to drive high-quality first-time deposits and long-term LTV.

Plan, allocate and actively manage six- and seven-figure monthly budgets across brands, markets and channels, optimizing toward CPA, ROAS and player value targets.

Lead advanced testing roadmaps (audiences, creatives, offers, landing pages, funnels) and systematize learnings into playbooks that can scale across the client portfolio.

Collaborate with client stakeholders, brand, CRM and content teams to align acquisition, retention and reactivation into one cohesive growth strategy per brand.

Work with analytics and BI to refine tracking, attribution, and dashboards, ensuring decisions are grounded in reliable data across devices and markets.

Develop channel mix and market entry strategies for new brands/geo launches, quickly validating new traffic sources and creative formats in high-risk verticals.

Proactively identify underpriced traffic, new networks and partnerships (incl. affiliates and media owners) and negotiate deals that improve unit economics for clients.

Ensure all campaigns operate within regulatory, compliance and responsible gaming frameworks for relevant jurisdictions and platforms.

Prepare clear, story-driven performance reports and strategic recommendations for senior client stakeholders, positioning the agency as a high-impact growth partner.

Mentor and upskill junior media buyers and specialists, fostering a performance culture built on curiosity, accountability and rapid experimentation.

Stay ahead of platform changes, privacy updates and iGaming advertising policies, translating them into practical opportunities and risk mitigation for clients.

Ideal candidate profile

5+ years in performance marketing with proven success scaling multi-channel paid acquisition in iGaming, betting, casino or similarly high-velocity, high-risk verticals.

Deep hands-on expertise in at least three of: Meta, Google Ads, TikTok, programmatic, native, push/pops and affiliate traffic, including media buying, optimization and creative testing.

Strong analytical mindset: fluent in funnels, cohorts, LTV, CAC/CPA, ROAS and cross-channel attribution, comfortable turning messy data into clear decisions and next steps.

Demonstrated experience building structured testing programs and scaling winners across multiple brands, markets and languages in an agency or multi-brand environment.

Solid understanding of iGaming compliance, geo restrictions, KYC/AML considerations and responsible gaming requirements across key markets.

Entrepreneurial, hands-on operator who thrives in a fast-moving agency setting, enjoys ownership, and is motivated by hitting ambitious growth and profitability targets.

Bonus points if the candidate is a confident client-facing communicator who can challenge briefs, educate stakeholders and translate complex performance insights into simple, commercial narratives.

Chewy

[Boston, MA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Boston%2C-MA)

Job Description:Our Opportunity:Chewy is looking for a Senior Marketing Manager, Performance Marketing Experimentation to join our team in Seattle, WA or Boston, MA, reporting to the Associate Director, Performance Marketing.As a Senior Marketing Manager, you will own the strategy and operating approach for testing new ways to capture demand and acquire customers through performance marketing. This is a senior individual contributor role where you will identify the platforms, partners, and customer opportunities that are most important for Chewy to explore, develop a roadmap for experimentation, and turn promising ideas into measurable programs. The initial focus will include display and retargeting, as well as emerging advertising environments such as agentic commerce, but the scope will extend to other opportunities as the market and customer behavior evolve.Customers are changing how they discover and choose products, and the advertising industry is changing with them. Many of the opportunities in this space do not yet have established audiences, measurement approaches, operating models, or playbooks. You will need to develop a point of view on where performance marketing is going, decide which platforms and partners are worth pursuing, and design experiments that help Chewy learn quickly without losing financial discipline. You will work across Marketing, Analytics, Product, Engineering, Creative, Merchandising, Finance, and external partners to shape solutions and determine what should be scaled.What You’ll Do:Own the roadmap for performance marketing experimentation, identifying opportunities across display, retargeting, emerging advertising environments, and other customer acquisition channelsDevelop a point of view on changes in customer behavior, advertising technology, and the competitive landscape, and translate that perspective into clear recommendations about where Chewy should invest time and resourcesLead experiments from hypothesis through decision, including the business case, audience strategy, creative and customer experience, measurement approach, financial guardrails, and scale criteriaDevelop and test display and retargeting opportunities that can expand Chewy’s ability to reach and convert high-intent customersLead exploration of emerging advertising environments, including agentic commerce, by ensuring platform readiness, defining use cases, and establishing a clear path from pilot to scalePartner with Creative, Analytics, Product, Engineering, Merchandising, Finance, and other Marketing teams to develop solutions that account for customer needs, technical requirements, and business prioritiesEstablish senior relationships with third-party platforms, publishers, and technology partners, influencing how they design advertising products, measurement solutions, data access, and integrations for ChewyDefine the testing standards and decision frameworks used to evaluate new opportunities, including incrementality, customer acquisition efficiency, reach, frequency, and downstream business impactMake recommendations about which opportunities to scale, refine, or stop, based on evidence and a clear understanding of both immediate results and longer-term potentialBuild repeatable operating models and playbooks that allow successful experiments to be adopted across the broader performance marketing programCommunicate strategy, progress, findings, and recommendations to senior leadership and partners across the companyWhat You’ll Need:Bachelor’s degree or higher in marketing, economics, business, computer science, or a related discipline7+ years of experience in performance marketing, ecommerce, growth marketing, digital advertising, product management, or a related fieldExperience developing and scaling new marketing programs, channels, partnerships, or customer acquisition capabilitiesStrong understanding of performance marketing, experimentation, customer acquisition, and measurement, including incrementality testingThe ability to evaluate emerging platforms and advertising opportunities, develop a clear point of view, and make thoughtful investment recommendationsExperience working with Creative, Analytics, Product, Engineering, Merchandising, Finance, and external partners to bring ambiguous ideas from concept to executionThe ability to define test plans, success criteria, financial guardrails, and scale decisions when there is limited precedent or incomplete informationStrong business acumen and analytical skills, including the ability to assess large datasets and translate findings into clear recommendationsStrong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to influence senior stakeholders and explain complex ideas in clear business termsExperience building senior relationships with third-party companies and influencing the design of solutions, products, or partnershipsA tenacious attitude for learning and taking on new challenges, and an entrepreneurial mentalityThe base salary range for this role is $110,500 - $176,000.00.The specific salary offered to a candidate may be influenced by a variety of factors including but not limited to the candidate’s relevant experience, education, and work location. In addition, this position is eligible for 401k and a new hire and annual equity grant. C08+ positions may also be eligible for annual bonus.We offer different types of insurance and benefits, such as medical/Rx, vision, dental, life, disability, hospital indemnity, critical illness, and accident. We offer parental leave, family services benefits, backup dependent care, flexible spending accounts, telemedicine, pet adoption reimbursement, employee assistance program, and many discounts including 10% off pet insurance and 20% off at Chewy.com. Exempt salary team members have unlimited PTO, subject to manager approval. Team members will receive six paid holidays per year. Team members may be eligible for paid sick and family leave in compliance with applicable state and local regulations. Chewy is an equal opportunity employer. # Senior Paid Media Channel Manager

Intelliswift - An LTTS Company

[New York, NY](https://jooble.org/jobs/New-York%2C-NY)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/6944841882899511758?p=1&pos=0&rgn=33025&pageType=7&jobAge=66&jdpSource=101&jdpid=3072950378430514988&crId=US_0US_0)

**Job Title:** Senior Paid Media Channel Manager

**Location:** New York, MY

**Duration:** 6 Months Contract

We are seeking an experienced **Senior Paid Media Channel Manager** to lead the strategy, optimization, and performance of enterprise paid media programs across paid social, search, and programmatic channels. This role is responsible for driving channel growth, improving campaign performance, managing cross-functional stakeholder relationships, and ensuring operational excellence across marketing campaigns.

The ideal candidate combines deep paid media expertise with strong analytical, marketing operations, and project management skills. You will work closely with integrated marketing, marketing operations, analytics, web, content, and agency partners to deliver measurable business impact.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Channel Strategy & Optimization:**

- Own the paid media roadmap and optimization strategy across paid social, search, and programmatic channels.
- Develop quarterly performance plans, priorities, and testing initiatives.
- Translate business objectives into channel strategies, KPIs, and performance targets.
- Identify performance opportunities and drive optimization initiatives from ideation through execution

**Campaign & Portfolio Management**

- Manage media investments across multiple products, campaigns, and marketing programs.
- Monitor performance, pacing, and budget allocation to maximize business impact.
- Partner with marketing stakeholders to support product launches, growth initiatives, and campaign objectives.

**Measurement, Tracking & Governance**

- Ensure campaign tracking accuracy and measurement integrity through tagging, tracking, and governance best practices.
- Manage audience strategy, segmentation, activation, and compliance standards.
- Maintain campaign naming conventions, taxonomy standards, and quality assurance processes.
- Partner with operations teams to establish scalable measurement frameworks.

**Marketing Operations & Integrations**

- Collaborate with marketing operations and technology teams on platform integrations and data flow optimization.
- Improve lead tracking, attribution, reporting, and operational efficiency.
- Identify process improvements and automation opportunities that enhance campaign performance.

**Testing & Innovation**

- Develop and manage a structured testing roadmap.
- Design experiments, define success criteria, analyze results, and implement learnings.
- Evaluate emerging advertising channels, formats, and measurement approaches.
- Document best practices, benchmarks, and optimization frameworks.

Vendor & Agency Management

- Lead agency and vendor relationships to ensure delivery quality and performance excellence.
- Manage briefs, timelines, deliverables, and service expectations.
- Drive accountability and continuous improvement across external partners.

**Required Qualifications**

- 8+ years of paid media experience with direct ownership of channel strategy and performance.
- Expertise in paid social advertising and strong knowledge of search and programmatic media.
- Deep understanding of campaign tracking, tagging, audience management, attribution, and measurement.
- Experience managing paid media roadmaps, campaign calendars, budgets, and cross-functional initiatives.
- Strong experience in testing, experimentation, and data-driven optimization.
- Hands-on experience partnering with marketing operations teams and supporting technology integrations.
- Experience managing agencies, vendors, and external partners.
- Excellent communication, analytical, and stakeholder management skills.
- Ability to thrive in fast-paced, evolving environments.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

- Experience in B2B technology, SaaS, cloud, AI, or enterprise software marketing.
- Experience supporting demand generation and lead generation initiatives.
- Familiarity with account-based marketing (ABM) strategies.
- Experience managing multi-product portfolios and global marketing programs.
- Knowledge of marketing automation, CRM systems, and attribution frameworks.
- Experience building audience governance and campaign measurement standards.
- Experience operating in large, matrixed organizations.

##### Senior Paid Media Manager

Do innovative, buyer journey-focused paid media campaigns make your heart flutter? Does leading a team of paid media specialists into brave new strategies sound right up your alley? Then you just might be the next member of our paid media team.

We're looking for talented, experienced and driven senior paid media managers to join the Nebo team. The ideal candidate will have at least three years of hands-on experience managing all types of paid media campaigns, including paid search, paid social, display and retargeting. The candidate should have strong communication, organizational and time-management skills (love of dogs, beer, and PTO also a plus). The senior paid media manager will work closely with the director of paid media to manage the team and will also lead the overarching paid media strategy for a variety of clients.

If you're looking for a role where you can be strategic, pet puppies and help grow a team of driven individuals while still being hands on with campaign management, this is the one for you.

Nebo is a human-centered agency built on a culture of respect, professional growth and care for every employee. With numerous perks, including hybrid in-office/remote work options designed to fit your needs, unlimited PTO, and free attendance to local marketing events, join this fun-loving team that occasionally talks Slack Smack.

##### Senior Paid Media Manager Duties

- Act / serve as a Paid Media subject matter expert
- Develop, execute, manage and report on paid media strategies that support client goals
- Lead strategic planning sessions and team meetings
- Review deliverables and provide feedback to other team members
- Assist in new business efforts/sales pitches
- Help create and execute educational initiatives for the paid media team such as developing internal resources and training sessions
- Stay on top of new and emerging industry trends, technologies, and platform advancements
- Conduct regular one on one meetings with other members of the paid media team in order to provide guidance and performance feedback
- Work with vendors and agency partners
- Help develop integrated digital marketing strategies in collaboration with other departments and client teams

##### Senior Paid Media Manager Skills Required

- At least 3 years experience in paid media
- Experience managing large budgets and campaigns across multiple digital advertising channels including paid search, paid social, display, retargeting, video, etc.
- A deep understanding of digital marketing tactics across channels including SEO, social, email, PR etc.
- Experience with programmatic platforms and media buys
- Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics, and Google Tag Manager experience
- Working knowledge of bid management and ad serving platforms
- Strong written and verbal communications skills
- Excellent research and analytical skills
- Strong Excel skills
- Ability to meet deadlines under pressure
- Ability to multitask and thrive in a fast paced environment
- Excellent time management
- Bachelor's Degree in area of practice or related field.

Description

PRIME Corporate Services is seeking a Senior Paid Media Manager to own paid customer acquisition across every channel we buy.

Reporting to the VP of Growth Marketing, this person is accountable for the performance of our paid media program: Google Search, Meta, and the emerging channels we have not built yet. You will own the accounts day to day, run the testing roadmap, own the conversion tracking that tells us whether any of it worked, and decide where the next dollar should go.

Accountability in this role does not stop at the booked consultation. Working closely with the Sales team, you are also responsible for the quality of the traffic we buy and the orders it ultimately produces. Volume that does not convert is not a win here, and a channel that looks efficient on cost per lead but poor on closed business is a problem you are expected to find and fix.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You will build the campaigns, write the ad copy, brief Design on creative, implement the tracking with Engineering support, and read the results yourself.

Analytical rigor is central to the role. A large share of this job is deciding what a number actually means: whether a CPA movement is signal or noise, whether a test has run long enough to read, whether a platform's reported conversions reflect real revenue. The best people in this seat are comfortable being the one who says the data does not support that conclusion yet, and equally comfortable acting decisively once it does.

A significant part of this role is expansion. Paid channels are proliferating faster than most teams can evaluate them, and we want someone who can design a real test for a new platform, run it with discipline, and tell us honestly whether to scale it or kill it. That includes AI-native inventory like ChatGPT Ads, where the targeting and optimization levers are limited and results depend far more on offer clarity and clean measurement than on platform sophistication.

You will own how and where our paid budget gets deployed. Material shifts to the total go through an approval step, but the channel mix, the strategy behind it, and the calls about what we test and where we scale are yours to drive.

Who we are
Remember when every step of launching your dream felt like a mountain? Debt loomed, the tax code was a cryptic puzzle, and building a rock-solid foundation seemed impossible. PRIME Corporate Services was forged from that very struggle - by entrepreneurs who knew there had to be a better way.

We are not just a faceless firm; we are a co-pilot for founders, operators, and business builders navigating the chaos of growth. We help cut through red tape, simplify complex systems, and help entrepreneurs structure their business for long-term financial freedom.

From entity structuring to tax strategy to business credit and funding, we don't just protect businesses - we help to scale them. Our team partners directly with high-growth entrepreneurs and affiliate partners to drive measurable outcomes; more leads, more revenue, and stronger businesses.

We deliver expert guidance and exceptional service at every stage of the business journey.

Our Mission: We aim to serve, advise, and support entrepreneurs every day.

Why You'll Love Working Here

Impact at scale: Your work will shape the experience of thousands of entrepreneurs working with PRIME.

Autonomy + Accountability: You'll be trusted to lead, experiment, and deliver results — no micromanagement, just momentum.

Collaborative Culture: You'll work alongside creative thinkers, engineers, and business leaders who care deeply about customer success and innovation.

Modernization Mission: You'll play a key role in bringing advanced tech, analytics, and discipline to a growing organization — setting the foundation for the next generation of PRIME's digital ecosystem.

Benefits & Perks

Competitive Compensation + performance based bonuses

Comprehensive Health Coverage - Medical, dental, and vision

Paid Time Off - Generous PTO, sick days, and paid holidays

401k with Company match (we match up to 4%)

Free soda and snacks

Robust Employee Resource Program with tele-health and more

New Channel Development

Job Description

Founded in 2006, Lycamobile is a solution for those who want to connect back home. As a leading international wireless carrier, we provide solutions to over 30 million customers across 24 countries, Lycamobile’s sheer span, focus on customer service and innovative business strategy has seen it outgrow its competitor set; achieving greater coverage of the European population than any other network operator.

Thanks to our dedicated team, we are continuously driving costs down without compromising on quality for our customers. With that ethos imbedded into our vision, Lycamobile is currently seeking a **Senior Paid Media Marketing Manager** located in the Newark, NJ area.

**Position Overview**

We are seeking a **Senior Paid Media Manager** to lead, manage, and optimize our digital media campaigns across programmatic (+ CTV & DOOH), Paid Search (Google, Bing), and Paid Social (Meta, TikTok, Snapchat). This role requires a unique mix of strategic vision and hands-on execution, with a strong focus on top- and middle-funnel tactics that fuel brand awareness, consideration, and demand generation.

You will own campaign performance end-to-end—planning, execution, optimization, and reporting—while providing actionable insights to maximize return on ad spend (ROAS), drive incremental orders, and expand brand reach.

**Performance Analysis & Reporting**

\- Monitor and analyze key performance indicators (KPIs), including CPA, ROAS, CTR, CVR, and LTV, to identify trends and areas for improvement.

\- Provide regular performance reports, insights, and actionable recommendations to stakeholders.

\- Leverage data from Google Analytics, Google Ads, Facebook Business Manager, and third-party attribution tools to drive campaign optimization.

Strategic Growth & Innovation

\- Identify and implement new opportunities for audience expansion, automation, and AI-driven optimizations.

\- Stay ahead of industry trends, algorithm updates, and best practices to ensure competitive advantage.

\- Explore emerging digital media platforms and strategies to expand Lyca Mobiles paid media presence.

**Key Responsibilities**

- **Campaign Management & Optimization**
 - Build, launch, and manage campaigns in-platform across programmatic, CTV, DOOH, paid search, and paid social channels.
 - Lead and mentor the Paid Media Manager in executing and optimizing lower-funnel campaigns across paid search, paid social and retargeting, ensuring performance targets are met and continuously improved
 - Optimize campaigns in real-time to improve efficiency, maximize performance, and achieve KPIs such as brand awareness, reach, engagement, and conversions.
 - Implement A/B and multivariate testing to refine creative, audience targeting, and bidding strategies.
 - Collaborate with the pricing team to develop and implement channel-level incentive strategies and promotional plans
- **Strategic Planning & Channel Optimization**
 - Develop and execute paid media strategies focused on driving upper- and mid-funnel performance, nurturing prospects through the customer journey.
 - Allocate budgets effectively across channels based on performance data, audience insights, and business priorities.
 - Identify new growth opportunities and emerging platforms/tactics to keep the brand ahead of the curve.
- **Performance Analysis & Reporting**
 - Monitor campaign analytics and produce regular performance reports with clear insights, learnings, and recommendations.
 - Collaborate with analytics teams to refine attribution models and measure incremental impact.
 - Present channel performance, trends, and optimization strategies to senior stakeholders.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

- Work closely with Affiliate, Organic Social, SEO, Creative and Analytics teams to ensure campaigns are aligned with overall marketing and brand objectives.
- Partner with media vendors, platforms, and agencies to maximize buying power and access to new betas.

**Qualifications**

- 5+ years of hands-on experience managing paid media campaigns across multiple channels, with emphasis on programmatic, CTV, DOOH, paid search, and paid social.
- Proven track record of delivering measurable results in both brand awareness and performance-focused campaigns.
- Deep understanding of top- and mid-funnel marketing tactics, audience segmentation, and customer journey mapping.
- Advanced proficiency in platforms such as Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, Meta Ads Manager, TikTok Ads Manager, Snapchat Ads Manager, and leading DSPs (e.g., The Trade Desk, DV360).
- Strong analytical skills with experience in tools like Adobe, GA4, Datorama or similar.
- Ability to balance strategic thinking with tactical execution.
- Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable insights for stakeholders.

We are hiring a Senior Paid Media Manager to personally own and execute our paid search and local acquisition efforts. This is a hands‑on, execution‑first role designed for an experienced PPC practitioner who wants direct ownership, accountability, and impact.
This is not a people‑management role and not a strategy‑only position. You will be in the accounts daily, making real optimization decisions and owning performance end‑to‑end.
If you enjoy building, optimizing, troubleshooting, and improving paid media performance yourself, and prefer ownership over delegation, this role is for you.
**What This Role Is (and Is Not) This role is:**
A team‑of‑one, individual contributor position
Deeply hands‑on and execution‑focused
Measured by real outcomes, not activity or meetings
Designed for a senior operator who thrives on accountability
**This role is not:**
A people management or team‑lead role
A brand awareness or upper‑funnel position
An agency oversight only role
A role where execution is delegated to others
What You Will Own Day‑to‑Day Paid Search (Google Ads) Build, manage, and optimize branded and non‑branded search campaigns
Defend branded terms against competitors
Manage bids, budgets, match types, negatives, ad copy, and extensions
Monitor impression share, CPL, CPA, and lead quality
Identify waste and reallocate spend quickly
Local Services Ads (LSAs) Own LSA setup, ranking, and ongoing optimization
Dispute invalid or low‑quality leads
Optimize service areas, hours, responsiveness, and lead mix
Partner with intake/operations to improve call handling and outcomes
Monitor review volume and velocity as a ranking lever
Performance & Attribution Track performance from click/call → qualified lead → outcome
Diagnose performance issues and implement fixes independently
Produce clear, honest reporting with actionable insights
Surface risks early and propose solutions
How Success Is Measured Lead quality and conversion rates
Branded search stability and efficiency
LSA ranking consistency and dispute effectiveness
Ability to independently manage and improve performance
What We’re Looking For Required
7–12+ years of hands‑on PPC experience
Deep expertise in Google Ads
Direct experience managing Local Services Ads
Experience in call‑driven, high‑intent lead generation
Comfortable operating independently with full ownership
Strongly Preferred
Personal Injury, legal, or other local call‑first industry experience
Experience disputing LSA leads and managing ranking volatility
Experience collaborating closely with intake or operations teams
Track record of improving efficiency, not just increasing volume
Why This Role Is Unique Full ownership with no handoffs
Senior‑level compensation for senior‑level execution
Clear expectations and accountability
Minimal bureaucracy and micromanagement
Direct impact on revenue and performance
Important Note for Applicants This role is best suited for a senior PPC practitioner who prefers execution and ownership over managing people. Candidates seeking a people‑leadership or high‑level oversight role will likely not find this position to be a fit.

About the job Senior Paid Search Manager
TITLE: Senior PPC Manager
TYPE: Full‑Time

## COMPENSATION RANGE: $160,000 – $190,000 (DOE)

LOCATION: Los Angeles, CA (Downtown Los Angeles)
WORK SCHEDULE: Onsite – Monday to Friday
INDUSTRY: Legal Services / Personal Injury

\*Must be authorized to work in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor for this position\*\*

## COMPANY INFO

A fast‑growing personal injury law firm operating in a high‑volume, high‑intent inbound lead environment. The organization is known for aggressive digital marketing, rapid scaling, and performance‑focused case acquisition systems.

ROLE

The Senior PPC Manager owns end‑to‑end PPC performance and attribution pipelines across high‑intent lead generation channels. This role builds, optimizes, troubleshoots, and scales complex paid acquisition systems to improve cost‑per‑case, lead quality, and overall case acquisition outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

Build, manage, and optimize Google Ads, Bing, Performance Max, YouTube, and Microsoft Ads campaigns.

Improve lead quality, CPL, ROAS, and cost‑per‑case through continuous testing.

Create and execute testing roadmaps across copy, bidding, landing pages, and audience strategies.

Manage Google Local Service Ads: performance, service areas, reviews, dispute resolution.

Maintain and optimize Google Business Profiles for accuracy and compliance.

Ensure flawless attribution and lead flow across Google Ads CallRail Intaker Salesforce.

Troubleshoot issues across Zapier, CallRail, chatbots, IVR routing, and CRM integrations.

Verify accurate attribution, prevent duplicates, and maintain Salesforce data integrity.

Conduct weekly call audits to evaluate intake performance and case retention quality.

Test call routing paths weekly to ensure correct queues, escalations, and language routing.

Analyze funnel performance (connected qualified contract sent retained).

Deliver weekly reporting on leads, spend, CPL, projections, and down‑funnel insights.

Present strategic recommendations, competitive analysis, and performance enhancements.

Train new staff on marketing systems, routing logic, workflows, and attribution.

Ensure compliance with Google Ads policies, brand standards, and security protocols.

Document system changes and maintain SOPs.

## REQUIRED & PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Required

9+ years hands‑on PPC experience in high‑budget, ROI‑driven environments.

Proven ability to improve CPL, ROAS, cost‑per‑case, and lead quality.

Expert‑level mastery of Google Ads, Performance Max, YouTube, Microsoft Ads, smart bidding, and audience strategies.

Experience integrating PPC with Salesforce or comparable CRMs.

Strong proficiency with CallRail, Zapier, chatbots, landing page testing, and dynamic tracking setups.

Deep analytical skills using GA4 and performance dashboards.

Demonstrated ability to build full‑funnel acquisition systems.

Personal injury or call‑based lead generation experience.

Preferred

Experience with Intaker, Unbounce, VWO, Segment, or IVR routing systems.

Experience working with intake or call center operations.

Senior Paid Social Manager
Remote: Latin America. (Colombia; Central and South America)
Salary: $2,000-$5,000 USD Monthly
Schedule: Monday - Friday. 9AM - 5PM PST ( Full time - 40 hrs per week)
You’ll work directly with the founder on paid social strategy and execution across Meta, TikTok, AppLovin, and Pinterest. Accounts range from $50K to $700K+ a month in spend. You’ll own the thinking and the hands‑on work: structure, testing, analysis, and the recommendations that come out of it. This role is paid social only. Paid search and creative production are handled elsewhere.
What You’ll Do Audit new accounts and present findings on structure, attribution, audience segments, placements, and demographics
Build and run account structures that consolidate signal instead of fragmenting it across hundreds of ad sets

Design creative and audience tests with a defined minimum spend per test, so every result is readable

Set up audience infrastructure, including customer lists, exclusions, and existing-customer spend controls

Build and maintain catalog and dynamic product ads across collections

Standardize attribution settings across campaigns and explain how window choices change reported results

Plan and read conversion lift studies, and translate incremental results into budget and target decisions

Write creative briefs from performance data and give clear feedback to client creative teams

Expand budgets onto TikTok, AppLovin, and Pinterest where the numbers support it

Report on business outcomes: Shopify revenue, MER, new customer acquisition, and contribution, not just platform ROAs

4+ years managing paid social, including accounts spending $250K+ a month in the e-commerce space

Expert-level Meta Ads Manager skills, including Advantage+ sales campaigns, CBO vs ABO tradeoffs, cost and bid caps, and catalog ads

Hands‑on campaign management experience on at least two of TikTok, AppLovin, and Pinterest

Working knowledge of the Conversions API, event match quality, and deduplication

A clear understanding of attribution windows, view-through credit, and why reported ROAS and incremental ROAS differ

Experience planning or interpreting conversion lift or geo holdout tests

Strong spreadsheet skills. You can pull raw breakdowns and build your own analysis.

Comfort presenting directly to founders and owners, including delivering findings they won’t want to hear

Strong English speaking skills
Nice to Have

Agency experience across several brands at once

Shopify analytics experience

Experience with product feed tools such as DataFeedWatch

Background in jewelry, apparel, or supplements

Remote Work: Work from anywhere—our team is global, and we value work-life balance.

Growth Opportunities: As a key player i you’ll have the chance to shape your role and grow with us.

Innovative Culture: Join a team that is passionate about leveraging data to solve challenges and drive success in a rapidly evolving market.

As part of our recruitment process, all candidates will be kindly asked to agree to Lago’s Confidentiality and Non-Circumvention Agreement. This ensures a respectful and professional experience for everyone involved.

**Who We Are:**
Power Digital is an AI-Native Growth Firm built at the intersection of world-class talent and proprietary technology. We help leading and emerging brands grow by combining deep vertical expertise, strategic thinking, and enterprise intelligence to drive measurable business outcomes.

For more than a decade, we have built our business around one belief: the best technology makes great people better. Our teams of strategists, creatives, analysts, and technologists use Omega, our AI operating system, to surface opportunities faster, investigate what is driving performance, and execute approved work with greater speed and precision. Behind Omega is Iris, our proprietary intelligence layer, built on years of real performance data, strategic frameworks, testing, and learnings from across our client portfolio. AI expands the capacity of our people to think, create, solve harder problems, and make better decisions. Human judgment, creativity, and accountability remain central to how we work.

As a people-first firm, we value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. We strongly believe our people and culture are key to our success. We partner closely with our clients as an extension of their teams, working across strategy, execution, and measurement to identify what is truly blocking growth and determine what to do next. Our culture is built on people who are curious, ambitious, accountable, and committed to delivering meaningful results for our clients and for one another.

At Power Digital, we believe the future belongs to teams that combine the best talent with the best technology. We are building that future today.

\*\*\*Proficiency in spoken and written English at an advanced level is required for this role.

**A day in the life:**

As a Paid Social Senior Media Manager, you’ll partner closely with your Media Supervisor to shape strategy and planning, while confidently leading client conversations, reinforcing strategic direction, and identifying testing or growth opportunities. You’ll support the Associate Media Director across key areas of media planning and own the daily management of campaigns, understanding performance drivers, optimizing with intent, and turning data into clear, actionable recommendations. You’ll collaborate with the creative team to develop new assets, messaging, and design concepts that elevate performance. With strong experience in Paid Social and a solid understanding of paid search and display, you’ll bring multi-channel expertise to the table and apply best practices across every channel you touch. This is a client-facing role, and your ability to guide, educate, and drive results will define your impact.

**Key Responsibilities:**

Successful end-to-end management of designated paid media accounts

Meet pacing and KPI requirements for held accounts

Work with Account Managers and the Media Supervisor to identify client goals, priorities and efficiency requirements.

Actively works to increase billing for existing accounts and propose opportunities to expand media coverage for new accounts

Continually work to learn new strategies, test new platforms, and expand Cardinal’s Paid Media offerings

Function as primary point of contact internally and externally for all ‘owned’ accounts.

Responsible for pacing and performance of accounts

Responsible for generating reporting, writing insights, and communicating performance insights with the client for designated accounts

Responsible for the ongoing maintenance of held accounts including but not limited to optimizations, structural updates, bidding methodologies, conversion types and copy revisions

Contribute strategic ideation on all accounts, designing and adjusting campaign strategies to meet each client’s business goals (and internal objectives)

Responsible for designing and deploying tests in accounts on a monthly and quarterly cadence (structural, targeting, creative & messaging, conversion, etc.)

Responsible for continual testing, verification, and improvement of full-funnel structures

**Role Requirements:**

4-5+ years of experience, primarily in Paid Social

Ideal candidates also have experience in multiple paid social channels, paid search, or programmatic

Required platform expertise: Meta Ads with LinkedIn, TikTok, or Reddit ads preferred

Suggested additional platform familiarity: Google Ads, Bing, a DSP platform

Experience managing paid media budget ranges above 100k per month

Experience driving paid media strategy and testing

Confident ability to communicate with and convince clients

Great at reporting and insights, and great at identifying and optimizing towards client business goals

Experience in full project ownership, from the first step of writing strategy briefs and recommendations, all the way to deploying campaigns/tests in-platform and reporting on results

Excellent communication, problem solving and interpersonal skills

Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite and Google Workspace

Ability to interface both with internal team members and clients

Ability to multitask and prioritize tasks effectively

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Pace within 98% of budget goal

Reaching conversion goals within 95% of target

100% of deliverables / tasks completed on time (by specified due date) or proactively communicate if delayedManaging a full workload indicated by $30K revenue/employee

Most Important Things (MITs)

Excellence in channel production and account performance

Excellence in internal and external reporting

Strong communication

$75k

Brownells, Inc.

[Mundelein, IL](https://jooble.org/jobs/Mundelein%2C-IL)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/8488054312816567069?p=1&pos=0&rgn=12729&pageType=7&jobAge=426&jdpSource=101&jdpid=7073845146919827485&crId=US_0US_0)

### Job Description

**Senior SEO & Organic Growth Specialist**

\\n

\\n

**Grinnell, Iowa \| Hybrid, 3 to 4 Days Onsite**

\\n

\\n

Brownells is looking for a **Senior SEO & Organic Growth Specialist** to help customers more easily discover our products, expertise, and content across traditional search engines and emerging AI-powered discovery platforms. **As a leading name in the firearms and outdoor industry, Brownells offers the opportunity to apply your SEO expertise to a large, specialized eCommerce catalog and highly engaged customer base.**

\\n

\\n

This is a hands-on senior individual contributor role for someone who understands both the technical and content sides of SEO and knows how to turn search visibility into measurable eCommerce growth. You’ll work across the website, focusing on technical site health, content strategy, AEO/GEO, and emerging search practices to improve qualified traffic, conversion, and revenue.

\\n

\\n

**What You'll Do**

\\n

\\n - Execute and optimize SEO and organic growth initiatives to increase visibility, qualified traffic, conversion, and eCommerce revenue
\\n - Conduct keyword research, competitive analysis, content gap analysis, and search trend research to identify growth opportunities
\\n - Optimize product detail pages, category pages, landing pages, and educational content for discoverability, customer relevance, and conversion
\\n - Perform technical SEO audits and recommend improvements related to crawlability, indexation, site architecture, structured data, internal linking, redirects, migrations, and website performance
\\n - Partner with developers, content specialists, designers, merchandising, and other stakeholders to ensure SEO recommendations are implemented effectively
\\n - Analyze organic search and eCommerce performance using Google Analytics, Google Search Console, SEMrush, and related tools, translating findings into actionable priorities
\\n - Implement and evolve AEO/GEO practices to improve visibility across AI-powered search experiences
\\n - Identify content opportunities across the customer buying journey and stay current on search engine changes, AI search developments, and evolving eCommerce SEO best practices
\\n

\\n

\\n

**What We're Looking For**

\\n

\\n - Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, merchandising, advertising, communications, or related field, or equivalent relevant experience
\\n - 3+ years of experience in SEO, eCommerce marketing, organic growth, content marketing, or a closely related digital marketing discipline; 5+ years preferred
\\n - Strong knowledge of eCommerce SEO, content optimization, and organic growth best practices
\\n - Experience with keyword research, technical SEO audits, competitive analysis, and organic performance analysis
\\n - Strong understanding of crawlability, indexation, site architecture, internal linking, structured data, redirects, and website performance
\\n - Proficiency with Google Analytics, Google Search Console, SEMrush, or comparable SEO and analytics platforms
\\n - Strong analytical skills with the ability to turn performance data into practical recommendations
\\n - Strong written communication, attention to detail, and the ability to independently manage multiple priorities and collaborate across technical, creative, merchandising, and business teams
\\n

\\n

\\n

**Preferred Experience**

\\n

\\n - eCommerce, retail, or large product-catalog environments
\\n - Military, law enforcement, tactical, outdoor, workwear, performance apparel, or adjacent consumer markets
\\n - Conversion rate optimization or customer journey optimization
\\n - AEO, GEO, AI-powered search, or emerging discovery technologies
\\n - Experience with large-scale site changes, redesigns, migrations, CMS, PIM, or product content management environments
\\n

\\n

\\n

**Why Brownells**

\\n

Search is evolving quickly, and this role will help shape how Brownells competes across both traditional and AI-powered discovery. You’ll have the opportunity to influence a large eCommerce catalog, strengthen the technical and content foundations behind organic growth, and directly connect your work to customer experience and business performance.

\\n

\\n

**Work Arrangement & Compensation**

\\n

This position is **hybrid in Grinnell, Iowa** , with an onsite expectation of **3 to 4 days per week** .

\\n

\\n

**Salary starts at $75,000, adjusted based on experience, plus bonus potential of up to 12%.**

\\n

\\n

**Benefits include medical, dental and vision coverage, a 5% 401(k) match, paid time off, paid holidays, exclusive employee discounts, and more.**

\\n

\\n

If you’re a hands-on SEO professional who enjoys digging into data, solving technical challenges, and turning search insights into measurable eCommerce growth, we’d like to hear from you. **Apply today** and help strengthen how customers discover Brownells across traditional and emerging search experiences.

Transmit

About Transmit:

We empower some of the most prestigious media partners in the world to deliver innovative Ad experiences to large scale audiences within premium OTT content. Our end-to-end platform delivers dynamic OTT streaming, experience-oriented advertising powered by cutting-edge creative technology. We have reinvented OTT advertising and raise the quality standards to drastically improve the experience for users, publishers and advertisers.

Overview:

Transmit is seeking a Senior Media Analyst to support the execution, management, and optimization of digital advertising campaigns across OTT, CTV, video, and programmatic platforms. This role is responsible for ensuring successful campaign delivery, monitoring performance, troubleshooting technical issues, and providing exceptional support to our clients and agency partners.

The ideal candidate has hands-on experience in digital media operations or campaign management, strong analytical and problem-solving skills, and a solid understanding of the digital advertising ecosystem. This is a hands-on role requiring the ability to independently manage campaigns, identify optimization opportunities, and collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to drive campaign success.

Key Responsibilities:

- Independently manage and optimize digital media campaigns (OTT, CTV, video, and programmatic) for top-tier clients across the US, ensuring delivery against KPIs and pacing goals.
- Monitor campaign performance, identify delivery issues, and proactively implement optimizations to maximize campaign effectiveness.
- Partner closely with media buying teams, agencies, and client stakeholders to maintain strong relationships through proactive communication and exceptional customer service.
- Provide technical and operational support to clients throughout pre-sales planning, campaign execution, and post-campaign analysis.
- Troubleshoot and resolve campaign delivery issues, including pacing discrepancies, targeting mismatches, creative errors, and reporting inconsistencies.
- Investigate discrepancies between first-party and third-party reporting to ensure accurate campaign performance measurement and billing.
- Conduct QA and trafficking checks on creative assets, targeting parameters, and campaign configurations to ensure compliance with platform specifications.
- Analyze campaign performance data and prepare detailed reporting, post-buy analyses, and actionable recommendations to improve results.
- Collaborate with internal Ad Operations, Sales, Product, and Engineering teams to resolve technical issues and improve campaign execution.
- Gather client and agency feedback to recommend platform enhancements and workflow improvements.
- Support the development and implementation of best practices and operational processes to improve campaign efficiency and accuracy.
- Provide guidance and support to junior team members on campaign management, troubleshooting, and reporting best practices.

Requirements:

- 2+ years of hands-on experience in digital media operations, campaign management, or ad operations. .
- Experience managing and optimizing digital advertising campaigns, preferably across OTT, CTV, video, or programmatic environments.
- Strong understanding of campaign trafficking, pacing, targeting, optimization, and reporting.
- Familiarity with digital advertising platforms, including DSPs, SSPs, ad servers, or other ad tech tools.
- Experience troubleshooting campaign delivery issues, reporting discrepancies, and technical challenges.
- Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret campaign performance data, identify trends, and recommend actionable optimizations.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Excel for reporting, data analysis, and campaign tracking.
- Ability to independently manage multiple campaigns and priorities in a fast-paced environment.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
- Detail-oriented, proactive, and solutions-focused, with strong organizational and problem-solving skills.
- Ability to collaborate effectively across internal teams and external client relationships.

Salary Range:$70,000–$75,000 annually, commensurate with experience.
