# Senior DTC Growth Strategist

$150k - $175k

Full-time

Kynship

[United States](https://jooble.org/jobs/United-States)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/1437775674236641174?p=1&pos=0&rgn=0&pageType=7&jobAge=114&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-3089723752119621775&crId=US_0US_0)

**About Kynship**

Kynship is a leading ecommerce growth agency specializing in scaling 8-9 figure DTC brands through data-driven strategies.

We partner with industry leading brands like Purdy & Figg and WildBird to optimize customer acquisition costs and maximize profitable growth through our three-pillar system: Forecasting, Creative, and Conversion.

We're growth partners who think about our clients entire business ecosystem, combining deep financial literacy with high-volume creative/offer testing and conversion optimization.

**The Role**

We’re seeking a Senior Growth Strategist to develop and execute comprehensive growth strategies for a portfolio of high-revenue DTC brands. This role requires a unique blend of financial acumen, paid media expertise (particularly Meta with cost controls), creative strategy, offer development, and account managementYou’ll manage brands ranging from 8- to 9-figures in revenue, building financial models, setting aMER targets, optimizing creative pipelines and offers, and scaling paid media with precision.

Equally important, you will serve as a strategic partner and advisor to clients;guiding C-level executives with insights, fostering strong relationships, and demonstrating the emotional intelligence needed to navigate both challenges and growth opportunities.

This position is highly strategic with minimal tedious or repetitive work. The most important part of this role is how you think, problem solve, and communicate solutions. You’ll be paired with an Operational Specialist who handles much of the execution such as building forecasts, launching ads, and coordinating creative production. That partnership allows you to stay focused on what matters most: analyzing performance, developing strategy, and driving client growth.

**Responsibilities**

**Strategic Planning & Forecasting**

- Develop financial forecasts and growth models grounded in unit economics, contribution margins, and CAC/LTV dynamics.
- Analyze aMER and spend efficiency for new customer acquisition, and model LTV and repeat-purchase rates to project returning customer revenue.
- Evaluate cost centers, including ad spend, cost of delivery/unit economics, and operational expenses, to identify opportunities for improved profitability and scalable growth.
- Set aMER targets aligned with client profitability goals, taking into consideration expected LTV and cost structures to drive sustainable growth.

**Meta Advertising**

- Leverage Meta’s machine learning to drive optimal results by focusing on strategic inputs (creative, offers, messaging) and efficient campaign structures, rather than relying on constant manual tinkering.
- Manage and scale high-spend Meta advertising campaigns (budgets in excess of $1M+ per month) with precision and control.
- Manage cost-control campaign structures that align with aMER targets, while effectively translating in-platform goals to blended aMER objectives.
- Set tailored targets across offers and SKUs with varying margin profiles to ensure alignment with overall client profitability goals.

**Creative Strategy**

- Drive high-volume creative testing to identify winning concepts and performance drivers.
- Deliver bi-weekly creative analysis to clients, reviewing ad account performance and explaining why specific ads, concepts, or formats are working.
- Translate insights into actionable creative direction, informing concepts and angles for UGC creators, static ad production, and client-generated content when assets are developed internally.
- Develop and propose new ad creative concepts and angles to test, with the goal of unlocking new audiences and driving growth at target performance beyond what has been tested to date.

**Offer Development & Profitability Strategy**

- Analyze product COGS and total cost of delivery to identify margin opportunities and design offers that maximize profitability while minimizing acquisition and fulfillment costs.
- Evaluate cart composition patterns (predictable vs. high-variation baskets) and structure offers accordingly, from prescriptive bundles to threshold-based incentives.
- Identify customer purchasing behaviors (e.g., common product pairings) and develop offers that amplify these behaviors to increase AOV and overall revenue.
- Balance short-term contribution margin with long-term LTV potential, tailoring offers to business models that rely on upfront profitability versus those built on subscriptions or repeat purchases.
- Test and iterate on discount levels, free gifts, and commitment-based offers to optimize conversion, AOV, and scalability.

**Client Partnership**

- Act as the primary strategic advisor for high-value client accounts.
- Lead client strategy sessions and present growth opportunities directly to C-level executives.
- Educate clients on key levers for profitable growth.
- Deliver creative and offer strategies that align with client business goals and drive sustainable performance.
- Demonstrate high emotional intelligence, social awareness, and exceptional communication skills, building trust, managing sensitive conversations, and guiding clients through both challenges and growth opportunities.

**Requirements**

**Experience**

- 2-4 years of hands-on experience managing and scaling Meta advertising for eCommerce (minimum 1+ year in a broader eCommerce growth marketing role).
- Proven track record scaling DTC brands and improving key growth metrics (CAC, LTV, contribution margin).
- Experience building financial models and forecasts grounded in eCommerce unit economics.
- Hands-on experience in creative strategy and offer development, translating performance insights into concepts, angles, and structured offers that drive profitable growth.

**Technical Skills**

- Expert-level proficiency in Meta Ads Manager (advanced campaign structures, optimization, cost controls).
- Strong analytical ability with Excel/Google Sheets for financial modeling and forecasting.
- Familiarity with landing page builders.
- Knowledge of attribution tools and analytics platforms.
- Understanding of A/B testing design, statistical significance, and experimental frameworks.

**Strategic & Interpersonal Abilities**

- Strong financial acumen with the ability to analyze P&L statements and calculate unit economics.
- Experience developing growth strategies aligned with business and profitability objectives.
- Ability to distill complex data into clear, actionable insights for both internal teams and clients.
- High emotional intelligence, social awareness, and exceptional communication skills, capable of building trust, managing sensitive conversations, and serving as a strategic partner to clients.

**Results Expected**

**90 Days**

- Successfully develop a clear understanding of their unit economics, cost structures, and growth objectives.
- Audit existing strategies and deliver an initial roadmap highlighting immediate optimization opportunities.
- Deliver financial forecasts and aMER targets that are validated and adopted by clients.
- Launch the first wave of creative and offer tests, with learnings translated into actionable next steps.

**6 Months**

- Consistently achieve aMER targets while meeting or exceeding agreed ad spend objectives on behalf of clients
- Generate measurable improvements in key growth metrics, such as new customer revenue at profitability targets and improved repeat purchase rates.
- Produce winning creative concepts and offer structures that are scaled across client accounts.
- Successfully manage up to $10M in monthly advertising spend across assigned accounts.
- Build trusted client relationships, reflected in strong feedback on both strategic insight and communication.

**12 Months**

- Be recognized as the go-to strategic advisor for assigned clients, leading regular C-level strategy sessions and growth planning.
- Establish a proven track record of unlocking new audiences and scaling through innovative creative and offer strategies.
- Demonstrate consistent client satisfaction and retention through strategic partnership, high EQ, and clear communication.

**Compensation & Benefits**

**Compensation**

- FOR US APPLICANTS $150,000 to $175,000 OTE (DOE). Base plus performance bonus tied to pod results.
- FOR UK APPLICANTS $110,000 to $120,000 USD OTE (DOE)
- **Full-time employee status with benefits.**

**Benefits**

- Health & Dental Insurance – Kynship covers 80% of employee premiums and 60% for dependents, effective the first day of the month following your hire date.
- 401(k) Matching – 100% match on the first 3% of pay, plus 50% match on the next 2%.
- Unlimited PTO – Encouraging flexibility, rest, and work-life balance.
- Remote Work & Flexibility
- Remote Office Stipend – One-time reimbursement of up to $300 for office essentials (monitor, desk, chair, etc.).
- Gym Reimbursement – Up to $50/month to support physical well-being.
- Internet Reimbursement – Up to $25/month with proof of billing via Gusto.

# Senior SEO Manager

Location:USCompany:Gameday Men's Health

## Description:

**About the Role**

We are looking for a Senior SEO Manager to lead a holistic SEO strategy across both national (brand-level) and local search for a rapidly growing network of clinics.

This role owns performance across the full organic ecosystem driving brand visibility, non-local keyword growth, and content strategy, while also ensuring strong, consistent local rankings, traffic, and lead generation across hundreds of clinic locations.

You will be responsible for building an integrated approach where national SEO strengthens overall authority and demand, and local SEO converts that demand into high-performing clinic-level traffic and leads.

Success in this role requires the ability to operate across both levels simultaneously, with clear accountability for local performance as a core driver of business results.

**Key Responsibilities**

**SEO Strategy Ownership (National + Local)**

- Own and execute a unified SEO strategy across national and local search
- Define how site-wide SEO (content, technical, authority) supports local visibility and conversions
- Identify growth opportunities across both national keyword rankings and location-level performance

**National / Brand SEO**

- Lead national SEO initiatives, including:
- Keyword strategy and content planning
- Optimization of core site pages (service pages, hubs, blog)
- Internal linking and site architecture improvements
- Authority-building (link acquisition, digital PR)
- Drive growth in:
- Non-branded and branded organic traffic
- National keyword rankings
- Site-wide engagement and conversions

**Local SEO & Multi-Location Performance**

- Own local SEO performance across 400+ clinic locations (growing to 1000+)
- Ensure locations are competitive in their markets for:
- Local pack / Maps rankings
- Geo-modified and “near me” searches
- Location page traffic and conversion performance
- Continuously monitor and improve organic leads at the clinic level
- Identify underperforming locations and implement targeted optimization plans
- Develop scalable frameworks to maintain strong performance across all locations
- Ensure clinic locations are visible not only in traditional local results, but also in AI-generated local recommendations and summaries

**Local Listings & GBP Management**

- Oversee Google Business Profiles and listings across all locations
- Manage listings via Yext or similar platforms
- Ensure accuracy, consistency, and ongoing optimization of:
- NAP data
- Categories and services
- Attributes and updates
- Drive improvements in engagement signals (calls, clicks, directions) and reviews

**Performance Analysis & Optimization**

- Monitor SEO performance across both national and local levels
- Diagnose issues across pages, keywords, and locations
- Develop strategies to improve:
- Local visibility and rankings
- National keyword performance
- Organic traffic and conversion rates
- Translate insights into scalable actions across teams

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

- Work closely with:
- Content and growth marketing teams
- Franchise marketing managers
- Web / product teams
- External SEO agencies
- Ensure alignment between national initiatives and local execution

**AI Search & Emerging Search Optimization**

- Own strategy for visibility in AI-powered search results and answer engines
- Optimize content and location pages to increase likelihood of being cited and surfaced in AI-generated responses
- Identify high-intent queries (e.g., “best \[service\] near me,” “top clinics for \[condition\]”) and ensure strong representation in AI search results
- Partner with content and SEO teams to structure information for:

Entity recognitionTopical authorityTrust and citation signals (E-E-A-T)

- Monitor presence and performance across AI search platforms and adapt strategies as these evolve
- Test and iterate on approaches to improve inclusion in AI-generated answers and recommendations

**Testing & Experimentation**

- Design and run experiments across both national and local SEO initiatives
- Test and scale improvements in:
- Content and on-page SEO
- Location page performance
- Internal linking and site structure
- Review and reputation strategies
- Test AI-driven approaches to improve rankings, content performance, and conversion rates
- Evaluate and implement new AI tools that improve SEO efficiency and scalability

**Reporting & Accountability**

- Own reporting across national and local SEO performance
- Track and communicate metrics including:
- National rankings and organic traffic
- Local rankings and Maps visibility
- Traffic and conversions at the location level
- Organic leads by clinic
- Provide clear recommendations tied to business impact

**Qualifications**

**Required**

- 4–7 years of SEO experience across both national and local SEO
- Experience managing SEO in multi-location / franchise network
- Proven ability to drive both site-wide organic growth and location-level performance
- Strong knowledge of:
- Technical SEO and on-page optimization
- Content and keyword strategy
- Google Business Profile and local ranking factors
- Experience with tools such as:
- Google Search Console
- Google Analytics
- Ahrefs / SEMrush
- Yext or similar local listings platforms
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
- Familiarity with how AI-driven search experiences (e.g., Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity) source, rank, and present information
- Experience optimizing content for entity-based search, structured data, and authoritative citation signals

Salary Range: $95,000 - $120,000 BOE, Full benefits

# Senior Paid Search Manager, Digital (Denver)

## Description:

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

The Senior Paid Search (PPC) Manager is the central hub for digital campaign execution and operational performance across a portfolio of accounts. This role serves as the client’s key point of contact for all day-to-day Paid Search matters, ensuring flawless delivery of the Account Director’s high-level strategic focus and the Operational Lead’s channel strategy and best practices.

For small to mid-size clients, this role may operate as the primary channel contact for assigned channels, alongside operational executives. If you are a data-driven paid search expert who thrives on precision execution, client partnership, and continuous innovation, this role is for you.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

- **Operational Client Liaison:** Serve as the primary client contact for all Paid Search campaign performance, reporting, timelines, and execution details.
- **Operational Excellence:** Oversee Paid Search channels and operational executives to ensure all campaigns are executed on time, on budget, and to the highest standard of quality, adhering to best practices and campaign KPIs.
- **Performance & Execution:** Act as the Paid Search operational expert, troubleshooting complex execution challenges and ensuring all campaign activities are aligned with strategy. Provide hands-on support for campaign optimization, testing, PCA, and other strategic needs. Establish innovation and testing roadmaps to ensure operational account growth.
- **Operational Efficiency:** Champion the use of proprietary AI technology to automate tasks and streamline workflows, maximizing operational efficiency.
- **Strategic Collaboration:** Partner closely with Account Directors to provide operational insights and data that inform strategic planning and effective measurement. Ensure tactical execution is viable and aligned with the client’s goals.
- **Team & Workflow Management:** Manage the flow of work and communication between the client and internal operational teams, ensuring briefs are clear and deliverables are met.

**WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR**

- 2+ years of experience managing digital advertising campaigns in Paid Search, with proven hands-on execution and optimization across Google Ads and Microsoft Advertising.
- Experience in other channels such as Paid Social, Programmatic, Retail Media, and Affiliates is desirable.
- Proven track record of meeting digital campaign performance KPIs.
- Hands-on, in-platform campaign management experience.
- A working understanding of tracking, tagging, and measurement fundamentals (UTM tagging, Google Analytics, platform tracking).
- Excellent analytical skills with a data-first approach to campaign strategy, performance, optimization, and decision-making.
- Demonstrated ability to manage multiple accounts and projects simultaneously to meet objectives and key deadlines.
- Strong communication and presentation skills, with experience liaising directly with clients.
- Highly organized, adaptable, and comfortable working across diverse campaigns and channels.
- Ad platform certifications are a plus.
- A genuine interest in digital marketing and a passion for continuous learning and innovation.

**WHAT REALTIME OFFERS**

- **Comprehensive Private Medical Insurance:** Full medical coverage with no out-of-pocket expenses, plus subsidized dental and vision plans.
- **Generous Paid Time Off (PTO):** 20 days of PTO annually, exclusive of federal holidays.
- **Enhanced Sick Leave:** Up to 10 additional days of sick leave to prioritize your health and well-being.
- **“Work from Anywhere” Flexibility:** 15 days per year to work from anywhere, supporting a flexible lifestyle.
- **Special Birthday Perk:** Enjoy a birthday morning lie-in to make your special day more enjoyable.
- **401(k) Retirement Plan:** 3% matched contribution to help secure your financial future.
- **Customisable Benefits Plan:** Choose benefits that fit your lifestyle with our benefits platform, Heka!
- **Attractive Bonus Scheme:** Access to an excellent performance-based bonus scheme to reward your contributions.
- **Global Reach & Growth:** Be part of a thriving, market-leading organization with opportunities for international travel and collaboration.
- **Continuous Learning:** Access a wealth of digital learning resources across programmatic, Google, influencer marketing, SEO, and affiliate marketing.
- **Vibrant Work Environment:** Join a fun, inclusive workplace with regular social events, breakfast and lunch gatherings, and office snacks.

**LIVING OUR VALUES**

Our values are at the core of everything we do. As part of our team, you are expected not only to deliver results but also to embody and promote our values in your daily work.

**Always Curious**

We are driven by a relentless pursuit of knowledge and discovery. Risk-taking and innovation are at our core; we explore uncharted territories. Learning from our experiences, we continuously push boundaries and aim high.

**Performance Driven**

We deliver precise, effective strategies tailored for our clients. Our focus is on data, science, and exploration to ensure high performance. We take ownership of our work, always seeking improvement and excellence.

**Relentlessly Ambitious**

We set high standards and push beyond what’s expected. Clear, direct communication drives us to achieve outstanding results. Proactive and determined, we see tasks through to completion and beyond.

**On the Front Foot**

Our commitment to our goals is unwavering and proactive. We seize opportunities to optimize and enhance performance. Dependable and driven, we deliver on our promises and keep pushing forward.

**Real and Authentic**

We build genuine, lasting relationships with clients and colleagues. Transparency and honesty are fundamental; we communicate openly. We collaborate with integrity and respect, fostering a trustworthy environment.

**Kind at Heart**

We stand by our values of kindness, respect, and integrity in all interactions. Deep care for our team and clients, always ready to support and help. Generous with our time and resources, we are reliable and always available.

**WHY REALTIME**

At Realtime, we are rooted in an independent spirit and a relentless drive for results for our clients. From day one we’ve propelled our clients over media hurdles, tackling complex challenges head-on and delivering measurable impact.

Our experts are platform masters with a record of shaping mindsets, amplifying presence, and igniting actions. Today, we add tech-powered solutions that provide unmatched speed, scale, and precision.

Our vision is to work with the world’s leading brands and be a shining example of agency services combined with tech — with an incredible roster of clients. We help clients achieve their goals. Our employees succeed and grow. We are Realtime.

# Senior Paid Media Buyer

Location:USCompany:Marketeam.ai

## Description:

**Senior Media Buyer, Meta and Google**

You are one of the best Meta and Google buyers alive, and you know it. Come own the paid media engine for an AI-native marketing company, and help our biggest clients win with it.

**Rolesnapshot**

**Why This Role Exists**

Paid media is the fastest lever we have, for us and for our clients. Marketeam.ai is an AI-native marketing platform: humans direct, and AI agents execute across paid media, AEO and GEO, SEO, design, content, social, and analytics. We need one world-class buyer who can set the standard for how paid media gets done here.

You will run our own Meta and Google programs as the proof that we practice what we sell. You will also be the expert our Customer Success Managers call when a mid-market or enterprise client needs paid media to move the number that keeps them renewing.

**What You Will Own**

**Internal pipeline**

Marketeam.ai paid media hits its monthly targets for qualified leads, booked demos, and pipeline

**Efficiency**

Cost per qualified lead and customer acquisition cost at or below target, with spend scaled only when the numbers hold

**Testing velocity**

A steady weekly cadence of creative, offer, audience, and landing page tests, with clear winners and losers

**Tracking you trust**

Conversions API, enhanced conversions, and offline conversions from HubSpot set up correctly, so we optimize to revenue, not clicks

**Client impact**

Client paid media accounts you consult on hit their goals and renew

**Playbooks**

Your best plays turned into repeatable playbooks that our AI agents and team can run

**What You Will Do** **Own Marketeam.ai paid media**

- Plan, launch, and manage every Marketeam.ai campaign on Meta and Google: Search, Performance Max, YouTube, Demand Gen, Advantage+, and lead campaigns.
- Own budgets and forecasts. Know where every dollar goes and what it returns.
- Scale winners with discipline: vertical budget increases, horizontal duplication into new audiences, and new placements when the numbers hold.
- Build the creative testing engine with design and content: hooks, angles, formats, UGC, and video.
- Partner with the sales team so every lead is tracked from first click to closed deal in HubSpot.


**Consult on client paid media**

- Partner with Customer Success Managers on mid-market and enterprise accounts where paid media is the constraint.
- Audit client Meta and Google accounts and write clear, prioritized fixes.
- Join client strategy calls, QBRs, and renewal reviews to explain what is working and what comes next.
- Set the plan, review the work of our AI agents and specialists, and raise the bar on quality.


**Stay ahead of the platforms**

- Track every major change in Meta and Google, and know what it means before our competitors do.
- Test new features early and share what you learn with the team.
- Help shape how Marketeam's AI agents buy media, so the platform gets smarter every quarter.


**Your First 90 Days**

**Days 1 to 30**

Audit every Marketeam.ai Meta and Google account and our tracking. Fix the biggest leaks. Present a 90-day paid media plan with targets.

**Days 31 to 60**

Your plan is live. Weekly testing cadence running. Offline conversions flowing from HubSpot. First client audits delivered with your CSM partners.

**Days 61 to 90**

Internal cost per qualified lead trending to target. Winners scaled. First paid media playbook published for the team.

**What You Bring** **Must have**

- 7 or more years of hands-on media buying on Meta and Google. You build and run campaigns yourself, not just manage people who do.
- You have managed $500,000 or more a month in combined spend, with results you can show in the ad accounts.
- Deep command of Meta: campaign structure, Advantage+, audiences, creative testing, scaling, and Conversions API.
- Deep command of Google: Search, Performance Max, YouTube, Demand Gen, bidding strategies, and enhanced and offline conversions.
- You live in the numbers: CPA, CAC, ROAS, pipeline, LTV, and incrementality.
- You can explain results to a CMO or CFO in plain language and defend your plan.
- Experience with B2B lead generation, ideally SaaS, and with DTC or ecommerce brands.


**Nice to have**

- Agency experience across many accounts and verticals.
- LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube, or Microsoft Ads experience.
- Experience with AI tools for creative, bidding, or reporting.
- HubSpot, GA4, and Google Tag Manager experience.


**How We Work**

- **Sell to the goal.** Every campaign ties to a business number, not a vanity metric.
- **One constraint at a time.** We fix the biggest leak first, then the next one.
- **Speed wins.** We test fast, cut losers fast, and scale winners with discipline.
- **If it is not tracked, it did not happen.** Clean data is how we earn trust.


**Compensation And Benefits**

- **Base salary:** $130,000 to $150,000, based on experience.
- **On-target earnings:** $175,000 to $200,000.
- **Variable, paid quarterly:** tied to Marketeam.ai paid media results (qualified pipeline and acquisition cost against target) and to retention of the client accounts you consult on.
- **Benefits:** Health, dental, and vision, unlimited PTO, employee equity pool, $1,500 annual learning budget


**How We Hire**

1. **Apply** with your resume and a 2-minute video: walk us through the best account you ever scaled on Meta or Google, and the numbers before and after.
2. **Screen call (30 minutes)** with the hiring manager.
3. **Account review (60 minutes):** share your screen and walk us through a live or past account you ran. Then we discuss a real paid media scenario.
4. **Culture interview (30 to 45 minutes)** with a CSM and another team member.
5. **Paid trial:** finalists audit a sample Meta and Google account and build a 30-day plan. We pay for your time.


**Equal Opportunity**

Marketeam.ai is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of every background and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. If you need an accommodation during the hiring process, let us know.

### Summary

**Job Description:**

**Position:** Ad Operations Specialist IV

**Location:** Toronto, ON

**Job Details:**

As a Paid Social Media Manager, you’ll bring Client's brand to life across social platforms through meaningful, data-driven campaigns that connect with diverse audiences and deliver measurable results.

Working within the US Brand & Media team, you’ll partner with colleagues across Client's, as well as with agencies and platform partners, to transform creative ideas and strategic storytelling into high-performing social activations. You’ll help shape regional campaigns that reflect Client's global brand vision—ensuring consistency, collaboration, and shared success across markets—while driving innovation, experimentation, and continuous improvement.

**What you will accomplish:**

- Develop and execute inclusive and effective paid social strategies that support marketing and business goals across the full customer journey—from awareness to conversion.
- Plan, launch, and manage social campaigns across multiple platforms, ensuring efficient budget use and alignment with key performance goals.
- Analyze and optimize campaign performance, translating business, customer, and platform insights into actionable recommendations that continuously improve results and inform future campaign strategy.
- Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, media planners, brand partners, agencies, and platform partners to ensure alignment, proactively resolve execution challenges, and drive successful campaign delivery.
- Test and learn: run A/B and multivariate tests to identify what resonates most—across creative, audiences, bidding strategies, and landing experiences—and apply those findings in future campaigns.
- Champion innovation: explore emerging platforms, tools, and formats to keep Client’s’ paid social presence fresh, relevant, and ahead of trends.

**What you will bring:**

- 6-8+ years of experience in paid digital media, including at least 4 years focused on paid social (Meta, TikTok, Reddit, YouTube, Snapchat, Pinterest).
- A strong grasp of social advertising, platform capabilities, audience insights, and evolving industry trends, with experience on YouTube/DV360, Reddit, TikTok preferred.
- Experience with live shopping or livestream commerce is a plus, with familiarity with shoppable video formats, creator-led selling, or marketplace-based live experiences strongly preferred.
- Validated experience running and optimizing campaigns with a data-informed, test-and-learn approach, including experience with CAPI, Pixel, App Measurement Partners, deep linking, and cross-device tracking and measurement.
- Excellent collaboration skills—comfortable working in a cross-functional, multicultural environment with diverse partners.
- Analytical approach and attention to detail, with the ability to translate data into clear, actionable recommendations, including experience leveraging first-party (1P) audiences and optimizing campaigns toward onsite customer behaviors across devices and operating systems.
- Strong communicator and relationship builder, able to influence and align across teams with empathy and clarity.
- Demonstrated ability to manage multiple high-priority campaigns simultaneously while exercising sound judgment, requiring minimal day-to-day direction, and bringing strong strategic thinking to execution.
- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

**TOGETHER, WE DELIVER HIGH-QUALITY SOLUTIONS**

At Hercules Sealing Products we are the premier name in the aftermarket hydraulic equipment repair parts sector. As a cornerstone of the fluid power industry, we leverage decades of expertise to meet the demands of partners worldwide, embodying the essence of a global leader originating from a foundation of unparalleled service and quality. We're excited about the future and committed to continuing this legacy.

Our success is deeply rooted in the caliber of our team members. We are committed to fostering a workplace culture that prioritizes employee development, encourages collaborative teamwork, and offers stimulating tasks paired with meaningful rewards for accomplishments.

Our culture is anchored in the values of Humble Servant Leadership, Engaging Environment, Respect, Customer Centric, Uncompromised Integrity, Leveraging Our Skills, Embrace New Ideas, and Surpass Expectations.

To be considered for this opportunity, you must reside and be authorized to work within the United States.

**Location:** On-site in Clearwater, FL.

**Compensation:** $100,000 - $125,000 + Bonus potential

**Job Summary**

The **Digital Marketing Director** is responsible for developing and executing digital strategies that drive revenue growth, customer acquisition, engagement, and conversion. This role leads the commercial performance and customer experience of the company’s e-commerce channels, including digital merchandising, search and product discovery, SEO, paid media, marketing automation, digital content, and performance analytics.

The Digital Marketing Director uses customer behavior, performance data, and market insights to identify opportunities to improve the online buying journey and overall digital experience. The role partners closely with Sales, Product Development, Customer Service, Marketing, and Software Development to translate commercial and customer needs into digital priorities, while Software Development retains ownership of technical architecture, development, integrations, infrastructure, and system functionality.

**Key Responsibilities**

- Digital Strategy: Develop and execute comprehensive digital marketing strategies that increase online revenue, customer acquisition, brand awareness, and market share.
- E-Commerce Management: Lead website merchandising, category optimization, product launches, promotional campaigns, and conversion rate optimization (CRO).
- Campaign Management: Plan, execute, and optimize integrated marketing campaigns across paid search, email marketing, social media, display advertising, remarketing, and other digital channels.
- Search Engine Optimization (SEO): Execute technical and on-page SEO strategies and improve organic search visibility.
- Marketing Automation: Manage lifecycle marketing including email campaigns, lead nurturing, abandoned cart programs, customer segmentation, and automated journeys.
- Sales Enablement: Develop product literature, technical bulletins, catalogs, presentations, and training materials.
- Market Research & Analysis: Conduct competitive analysis, VOC initiatives, and customer behavior analysis.
- Content Strategy: Develop website content, technical resources, blogs, videos, and customer communications.
- Performance Analytics: Utilize CRM, ERP, Google Analytics, and BI tools to monitor KPIs and ROI.
- Website Optimization: Improve usability, search functionality, navigation, personalization, mobile experience, and conversion performance.
- Product Marketing: Support product launches, merchandising, pricing initiatives, and digital positioning.
- Event Coordination: Support trade shows, webinars, customer events, and conferences.
- Relationship Management: Build relationships with customers, sales teams, partners, agencies, and technology vendors.
- Budget Management: Manage marketing budgets and optimize ROI.
- Leadership: Lead internal marketing resources, agencies, and cross-functional teams.

**Qualifications & Skills**

_Experience_

- Minimum of 7 years of progressive experience in digital marketing, e-commerce, product marketing, or related leadership roles.
- Experience driving measurable revenue growth through digital channels.
- Experience with website optimization, SEO, paid media, and marketing automation.
- Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives.
- Experience managing agencies and marketing technology platforms.
- Education: Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field.
- Technical Knowledge: Experience within hydraulic, industrial, manufacturing, motion control, fluid power, or other technical industries is strongly preferred.

_Skills_

- Strong strategic planning, analytical, and problem-solving abilities.
- Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills.
- Strong project management and organizational skills.
- Proficiency with CRM, ERP, Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, Google Search Console, and marketing automation platforms.
- Working knowledge of SEO, paid media, and website merchandising.
- Creative, data-driven mindset.
- Ability to work effectively in a collaborative organization.

Travel: Ability to travel as required for customer visits, sales meetings, industry conferences, and trade shows.

**Success Measures**

- Growth in digital revenue and online sales.
- Website conversion rate and customer acquisition.
- Organic search traffic and SEO performance.
- Return on advertising spend (ROAS) and campaign ROI.
- Customer engagement and lifecycle marketing performance.
- New customer registrations and lead generation.
- Successful product launches and digital initiatives.
- Continuous improvement of website performance and customer experience.

# Digital Marketing Director

Confidential

[Nashville, TN](https://jooble.org/jobs/Nashville%2C-TN)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/3909448052142982471?p=1&pos=0&rgn=44757&pageType=7&jobAge=90&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-2931280166751380706&crId=US_0US_0)

A rapidly growing, multi-site healthcare organization headquartered in Tennessee is seeking a Director of Digital Marketing to lead and scale its digital growth strategy. This individual will play a critical role in driving patient acquisition, optimizing marketing performance, and strengthening brand visibility across a distributed network of healthcare locations.
The ideal candidate brings a strategic mindset combined with hands-on expertise in CRM platforms, SEO, paid search (Google Ads), and multi-site digital campaign execution within a regulated healthcare environment. This role partners closely with executive leadership, operations, and clinical teams to ensure marketing initiatives directly support organizational growth objectives.
Key Responsibilities Lead and execute a comprehensive digital marketing strategy across a multi-location healthcare platform
Own and optimize CRM strategy, including lead management, patient journey mapping, attribution, and conversion tracking
Drive organic growth through SEO strategy, local search optimization, and ongoing content performance analysis
Oversee Google Ads and paid media campaigns, managing budgets, performance metrics, and ROI optimization
Develop and manage integrated digital campaigns across search, display, social, email, and web
Partner with internal stakeholders to align marketing initiatives with operational and clinical goals in a remote environment
Analyze performance data and deliver clear insights and recommendations to senior leadership
Ensure all digital initiatives comply with healthcare regulations and brand standards
Lead, mentor, and collaborate with internal team members and external agency partners
Qualifications 8+ years of progressive digital marketing experience, preferably within healthcare or highly regulated industries
Proven success managing multi-site or multi-brand digital marketing strategies
Deep expertise in CRM platforms (Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar)
Strong command of SEO, SEM, and Google Ads with measurable growth results
Experience building and scaling data-driven digital campaigns
Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate data into actionable insights
Leadership experience with distributed teams and external vendors
Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field (Master’s preferred)
Why This Role Fully remote leadership role with national impact
Organization headquartered in Nashville, TN
Opportunity to shape and scale enterprise-level digital marketing strategy
Collaborative, mission-driven healthcare organization
Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits package

**About Us** HEI manages an unparalleled portfolio of leading full-service branded hotels and luxury and lifestyle independent hotels across the U.S. We are the acknowledged experts on upper-upscale, luxury, and premium select-serve hotels in urban, super-suburban, and destination locations. At HEI, we recognize that our enormous success is solely the result of our greatest asset: Our People. Where people work is a choice. Against that choice, our greatest obligation is to ensure day in and day out that our associates have the compensation and benefits they deserve and industry leading tools, training and support that they need to excel. At HEI, simply said, we honor the privilege of our associates choosing us by investing in and making them more valuable.

Don't meet every single requirement of this job? At HEI we are dedicated to building a diverse and inclusive workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to still send in your information. You may be the perfect candidate for this or for other roles within our organization!

We value U.S. military experience and invite all qualified military candidates to apply.

**Compensation**

Salary Range: $100,000.00 - $115,000.00 AnnuallyTipped/Service Charge Eligible? NoDiscretionary Performance Bonus Eligible? Yes

**Overview**

The Enterprise Director of Marketing is responsible for managing all areas of public relations, all PR and Marketing information on websites, digital marketing and programming and brand/collateral identity. This position will be based remotely supporting 3-4 hotels at a time.

**Job Responsibilities:**

Public Relations

- Build strategic partnerships (link building campaign)

- Coordinate with operations & reservations teams to build packages and source add-ons

- Coordinate Press Release approval and distribution

- Field media inquiries and conduct on-site media tours

- Create press kits for visiting media and develop targeted media amenities

- Communicate presence of in-house media to hotel teams

- Attend and coordinate photographers for high-profile events on-site at supported hotels

- Supervise on-site video/photo shoots

- Participate in weekly PR calls/meetings

- Save all incoming clips and maintain clip books

- Monitor CVB PR leads

- Maintain log of past high-profile guests

- Prepare Image disks


Digital Marketing

- Develop and advertise promotions on each hotel's home pages

- Conduct SEO conference calls

- Responsible for ongoing maintenance and monitoring of hotel websites and third party websites

- Responsible for managing hotel's Social Media pages


Programming and Advertising

- Create and manage annual programming calendars

- Develop, plan, and market monthly property activations

- Create and implement advertising calendar

- Maintain advertising insertion orders/P.O.s

- Provide art direction and responsible for all advertising and marketing campaigns

- Coordinate email blasts for each hotel to extend promotional reach

- Accommodate field advertising requests

- Coordinate all outgoing ads (both web and print)


Hotel Responsibilities

- Attend weekly Sales meetings and staff meetings

- Communicate PR/marketing initiatives to key members of hotel staff

- Provide support to hotel team members as needed

- Performs any other job related duties as assigned.


**Qualifications:**

- Must have experience as a Director of Marketing or Marketing Manager at a hotel.

- 3+ years of past public relations/marketing experience.

- Essential prior experience in the field of hospitality with specific experience in public relations.

- Ability to work varying schedules to reflect the business needs of the Hotel.

- Ability to multitask.

- Ability to leverage Brand and enterprise processes and systems to support compliance, identify trends and support execution of strategies.

- Excellent working knowledge of Microsoft office, Excel, PowerPoint, InDesign, Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator.

- Strong analytical skills, ability to identify relevant data and leverage to positively impact hotel revenues.

- Ability to effectively communicate and influence key leaders in the organization.

For your physical and mental wellness we offer competitive Medical and Dental programs through Anthem Blue Cross Blue Shield as well as Vision insurance programs ​through EyeMed. ​Our Vacation, Sick and Holiday programs are available for you to rejuvenate with time off. HEI also provides pet insurance through the ASPCA. Specific details and eligibility of these programs vary by location and employment status.

### Job Overview – Director of Digital Marketing

Compensation: $200,000 – $250,000/year + bonus

Location: Waltham, MA

Schedule: Monday to Friday (Hybrid)

Atlantic Group is hiring a Director of Digital Marketing in Waltham, MA for our client, supporting enterprise digital marketing, marketing technology, customer engagement, and commercial growth initiatives. This executive leadership role will drive digital strategy across marketing, product management, sales, and technology while leading digital transformation initiatives that improve customer acquisition, product adoption, and business performance. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience leading digital marketing within the medical device, healthcare, life sciences, or related B2B industries.

### Responsibilities as the Director of Digital Marketing

- **Digital Strategy:** Develop and execute digital marketing strategies that increase brand awareness, customer engagement, lead generation, and business growth.
- **Marketing Technology:** Lead the optimization of marketing technology, automation, customer data, analytics, and AI-enabled marketing capabilities.
- **Campaign Management:** Oversee integrated digital marketing campaigns across web, email, search, paid media, social media, and other digital channels.
- **Analytics & Performance:** Establish KPIs, analyze campaign performance, and leverage customer insights to improve marketing effectiveness and ROI.
- **Digital Transformation:** Identify opportunities to enhance digital capabilities, marketing processes, customer experiences, and technology adoption.
- **Leadership & Collaboration:** Lead and develop the digital marketing team while partnering with cross-functional stakeholders and external agencies on strategic initiatives.

### Qualifications for the Director of Digital Marketing

- **Education:** Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field is required. MBA is preferred.
- **Experience:** 10+ years of progressive digital marketing, marketing technology, or marketing operations experience, including leadership experience, is required.
- **Industry Knowledge:** Experience within healthcare, life sciences, medical devices, B2B technology, or another regulated industry is preferred.
- **Technical Skills:** Experience with CRM platforms, marketing automation, digital analytics, SEO, customer data platforms, and AI-enabled marketing technologies is required.
- **Skills & Attributes:** Strong leadership, communication, analytical, and project management skills with the ability to lead digital initiatives, influence stakeholders, manage multiple priorities, and drive measurable business results.

Company DescriptionAt Lakeshore, we create innovative learning materials and world-class guest experiences for teachers, parents and children. Since 1954, we’ve grown into a global community—with a thriving e-commerce business, multiple catalogs, over 50 stores, a peerless national sales force, plus international offices that support our preeminent supply chain division. But today we’re working better, smarter and faster than ever—and setting our sights even higher. We’re building an infrastructure designed for scalability, embracing data-driven decision-making and using technology to improve efficiency and ensure the best tools for the best work. Most importantly, we continue to invest in a diverse team of inquisitive top talent who fuel each other’s passions and curiosity, take risks, try new things and believe that every new day brings opportunities for growth.Job DescriptionWe are seeking a VP of B2C & Digital Marketing to lead the vision, strategy and growth agenda for Lakeshore’s consumer and digital marketing. In this role, you’ll shape integrated B2C marketing strategies that drive customer acquisition, engagement, retention and eCommerce growth, while building long-term equity in a brand teachers and parents have trusted since 1954.This position is designed for a senior marketing leader with deep expertise across the B2C and digital ecosystem, including loyalty, customer lifecycle marketing, CRM, email, social, paid media, SEO, digital commerce, retail and omnichannel marketing. You bring strategic vision and operational discipline in equal measure, you know how to integrate these channels into one growth strategy that increases customer lifetime value, and you’d rather test a promising idea than debate it.You’ll lead a multi-team marketing organization and collaborate closely with executive leadership and partners across eCommerce, Merchandising, Product Development and Creative. You’ll join a curious, collaborative team that holds a high bar for results and keeps teachers, parents and children at the center of every decision. It’s meaningful work, because the campaigns you lead help more kids discover a love of learning.A day on the job looks like this:Shaping the B2C and digital marketing vision, strategy and growth agenda, integrating loyalty, acquisition, retention, eCommerce, CRM, social and performance marketing to drive revenue, customer lifetime value and market shareOverseeing the B2C marketing portfolio, budget and resource allocation, and ensuring accountability for revenue, profitability, conversion, retention and return on marketing investment (ROMI)Architecting loyalty, retention and customer lifecycle programs that turn first-time buyers into longtime Lakeshore families across digital and retail channelsSynthesizing consumer insights, market intelligence, competitive trends and digital analytics to identify growth opportunities and improve the end-to-end customer experienceLeading omnichannel and performance marketing across paid media, SEO, email and social, using audience segmentation, personalization and testing to optimize the customer journeyBuilding, coaching and mentoring a high-performing marketing organization where people are encouraged to experiment, learn and grow, developing future leaders and resolving critical talent gaps as the business growsTransforming marketing capabilities by integrating new technologies, processes and operating models that support future growthInfluencing executive decisions and collaborating with eCommerce, Merchandising, Product Development and Creative to align marketing priorities with company growth goals and represent the teachers and families we serveQualificationsGot the skills and experience? expertise across the B2C marketing ecosystem, including loyalty, CRM, lifecycle, email, social, paid media, SEO, digital commerce and omnichannel marketingExperience overseeing significant marketing investments, including budget planning, forecasting, performance measurement and ROI managementStrong command of customer journey mapping, audience segmentation, personalization, testing and marketing analyticsExperience leading marketing transformation initiatives, such as new technologies, processes or operating modelsPreferred:B2C retail experience, ideally with an omnichannel brand that sells through both stores and eCommerceExperience balancing long-term brand stewardship with short-term business performanceA strong eye for creative excellence and the ability to evaluate campaigns through both a strategic and customer lensWhat Sets You Apart:You pair creativity with analytical rigor and can explain the “why” behind every investmentYou make sound decisions without complete information, then assess and adjustYou develop future leaders and guide teams through change with resilience and optimismYou’re down-to-earth and approachable, and you lead with curiosity rather than egoAdditional **Job Description:** MGA Entertainment is seeking a dynamic and strategic Vice President of Digital Marketing to lead our digital marketing efforts and drive growth through innovative digital strategies. 08. **Social Media Management:** Oversee social media strategy and execution to build and maintain a strong online community.

10. **Budget Management:** Manage the digital marketing budget effectively, ensuring efficient allocation of resources to achieve desired results.

- Exceptional communication and presentation skills.
- Experience managing agency partners.
- Experience in toys / kids landscape preferred.
- Creative thinker with the ability to generate innovative ideas.
- Proficiency in marketing software and analytics tools.
- Passion for toys, entertainment, and children's products is a plus.

MHI RJ Aviation Group

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/4895301656867759974?p=1&pos=0&rgn=10&pageType=7&jobAge=17758050&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-9041598130039269752&crId=US_0US_0)

### Vice President, Marketing Communications

Company Name: Mitsubishi Power Americas, Inc.

Location: Lake Mary, FL, US, 32746

At Mitsubishi Power, we’re not just building better clean energy technologies; we’re architecting a better future. Our team is boldly redefining power generation and energy storage to fast‑track the world’s energy transition. We operate as one team, pushing toward our vision of the future. At Mitsubishi Power, we value problem‑solvers, prioritize collaboration, and support each other in an inclusive culture created through accountability and authenticity by demonstrating our core values of: Safety, Family, Innovative, Inclusive, Accountable & Courageous. Together, we’re building the future we all aspire to — making net zero a reality. One team, one future.

### Role Overview

The Vice President, Marketing Communications is responsible for developing and executing Mitsubishi Power Americas’ integrated marketing communications strategy to strengthen brand equity, accelerate business growth, enhance customer engagement, and elevate corporate reputation. Reporting to the Head of Marketing, this executive leader provides strategic direction across brand management, executive and employee communications, digital marketing, media relations, events, and stakeholder engagement.

The Vice President serves as a trusted advisor to executive leadership and partners closely with business unit leaders, corporate functions, and global marketing teams to advance strategic priorities, improve market positioning, and deliver measurable business outcomes. This role leads the Marketing Communications organization and oversees a business partner model that ensures marketing communications resources are aligned with commercial objectives, enterprise priorities, and customer needs.

### Key Responsibilities

Demonstrated leadership in developing and executing integrated B2B marketing communications, corporate reputation, employee communications, digital marketing, and event programs that drive business growth and strengthen brand equity. The ideal candidate will have demonstrable ability to conceptualize and implement marketing initiatives that drive Mitsubishi Power engagement and sales with its customers, prospects, and employees:

- Strategic B2B marketing and communications leadership
- Brand management and corporate reputation development
- Business partner model leadership connecting MarComm resources to business units and corporate functions
- Appreciation for and communication of company culture and change management efforts
- Executive communications and media relations
- People leadership and talent development
- Experience leveraging AI-enabled marketing tools, data‑driven marketing practices, and digital transformation initiatives.
- Strategic business acumen and commercial mindset
- Enterprise leadership and organizational influence
- Executive presence and stakeholder management
- Change leadership and organizational communications
- Budget planning and resource allocation

**Strategy & Leadership**

- Develop and execute the corporate marketing communications strategy.
- Lead and develop the Marketing Communications organization, including Brand & Reputation, Internal Communications, Digital Marketing, Events, and Business Partner functions.
- Establish and optimize a high‑performing Marketing Communications business partner model that aligns communications, branding, and marketing resources to strategic business priorities, customer engagement objectives, and revenue growth initiatives.

**Brand & Reputation**

- Develop and execute enterprise reputation management strategies that strengthen Mitsubishi Power’s position as an industry leader.
- Own corporate branding and enterprise messaging.
- Ensure consistent brand standards across all channels.
- Own media relations, public relations, reputation management, and external communications strategy, ensuring effective execution through internal teams and agency partners.

**Executive & Employee Communications**

- Partner with executive leadership to develop strategic messaging, executive communications, thought leadership initiatives, speeches, presentations, and stakeholder engagement strategies that support corporate objectives and market positioning.
- Own employee communications supporting company values, vision, and strategy.

**Digital Marketing**

- Provide executive oversight of website, social media, digital advertising, agency partners, marketing operations, analytics, and digital communications processes.
- Establish KPIs and report results to leadership.
- Drive digital transformation initiatives by leveraging analytics, customer insights, marketing automation, AI‑enabled technologies, and data‑driven decision making to improve customer engagement and marketing effectiveness.

**Events & External Engagement**

- Coordinate event strategy across business units and optimize spending.
- Oversee trade shows, customer events, technical conferences, and corporate events.

**Global Collaboration**

- Serve as the regional marketing lead with MHI HQ and other Mitsubishi Power regions.

**Requirement**

- Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, Engineering, or a related field; MBA preferred.
- 15+ years of progressive marketing and communications leadership experience, including significant experience leading enterprise‑wide marketing communication strategies, managing teams, and supporting commercial growth objectives.
- Experience in energy, industrial, manufacturing, or technology sectors strongly preferred.
- Proven success in building brands, leading teams, and supporting business growth through integrated marketing programs.
- Experience working with executive leadership teams and external stakeholders.
- Strong understanding of digital marketing, analytics, CRM, and modern marketing technologies.
- Demonstrated success leading and developing high‑performing teams.
- Proven ability to influence executive leaders and drive alignment across complex organizations.
- Experience managing external agencies, consultants, and strategic partners.
- Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation communication skills.
- Experience working within global organizations and matrixed environments preferred.

**WHY SHOULD YOU APPLY?**

- Excellent Benefits (Medical, Dental, Vision & 401K Matching).
- Excellent growth and advancement opportunities.
- Tuition reimbursement and on‑the‑job training.
- Paid vacation, sick time and holidays.
- Committed to quality products and services.
- Great working environment and culture.
- Employee Appreciation Programs and Events.

Mitsubishi is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) employer actively seeking to diversify the workforce and is committed to a policy of equal employment opportunity. Therefore, all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other legally recognized protected basis under applicable law, are strongly encouraged to apply.

# Director, Performance Marketing

Viral-Natio

[Chicago, IL](https://jooble.org/jobs/Chicago%2C-IL)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/4301595091404569300?p=1&pos=0&rgn=11886&pageType=7&jobAge=17758050&jdpSource=101&jdpid=2554593568968862196&crId=US_0US_0)

At **Viral Nation,** we specialize in building social-first ecosystems for brands to connect with the modern consumer journey. Our integrated solutions align strategy, talent, media, and technology with culturally relevant creativity to scale the world’s fastest-growing digital brands. Viral Nation offers a fluid, creative, and growth-oriented environment that will support your ambitions to apply your talents in an open, collaborative, and fast-paced culture. Our ability to stay at the forefront of the industry has fuelled our success and will guide us in paving the path forward. We’re driven to push boundaries and think beyond today to deliver strategies, and we’re just getting started.

While we continuously exceed our goals, we need your help – our success is only as great as our people. Strong performance leads to high expectations, and we must keep raising the bar!

The Director, Performance Marketing owns the craft, standards, and delivery quality of Viral Nation's performance marketing practice across paid social, paid search, and programmatic. You lead Associate Directors and their portfolios, set the bar for strategy and measurement, manage senior client relationships, and drive retention and growth across the book.

### What You'll Do Here:

- Own the strategy, quality, and performance of the paid media practice across a multi-client book and a significant media investment.
- Lead and develop Associate Directors, and through them, Managers and their teams.
- Set practice-wide standards for media planning, audience strategy, testing, QA, and measurement (attribution, incrementality, MMM / MTA).
- Serve as senior client lead and executive escalation point on the most strategic accounts, safeguarding retention and satisfaction.
- Drive organic growth across the book, partnering with account leadership and the Performance Growth track to expand scopes.
- Own platform strategy and technical application for delivery — turning partner alphas, betas, and product roadmaps into in-account plays, and owning team platform certifications and best-practice standards — in partnership with the Director, Performance Growth, who holds the agency-level partner relationship.
- Guide platform strategy and senior relationships across Meta, Google, TikTok, and DSPs, including access to betas and certifications.
- Champion adoption of new capabilities and AI-enabled workflows across planning, buying, optimization, and reporting.
- Partner cross-functionally with Strategy, Creative, Influencer, Business Intelligence, and Client Services for integrated, full-funnel delivery.
- Contribute to forecasting, resourcing, and utilization for the delivery team in partnership with leadership.

### What You Need To Have:

- 8+ years of performance marketing experience across paid social, paid search, and programmatic, including 3+ years in a leadership or management role.
- Strong agency-side track record leading strategy and delivery across a multi-client portfolio with meaningful media investment.
- Proven people leadership: building, coaching, and retaining high-performing teams.
- Deep measurement expertise (attribution, incrementally, MMM / MTA) and command of the evolving privacy and signal-loss landscape.
- Excellent executive communication and client storytelling at the senior stakeholder level.
- Proficiency in the Google / Microsoft Suite and project management platforms (monday.com, Asana, or comparable).
- Comfort operating in a high-growth, fast-paced agency environment.

### Compensation Philosophy:

At Viral Nation, compensation is structured, performance-led, and market-aligned. Pay decisions are intentional, based on role requirements, performance, and market alignment by country, and are set to maintain internal pay equity across comparable roles and levels.

Compensation progression is tied to demonstrated performance, expanded scope, and sustained contribution over time, not tenure alone. Employee compensation is reviewed regularly through formal performance reviews and check-ins to ensure alignment with role expectations and impact.

### AI in Recruitment:

Viral Nation does not use AI-enabled tools to screen, assess, rank, or select candidates – our hiring teams make all hiring decisions. AI note-taking tools may be used during interviews.

### DEI Commitment:

Viral Nation is committed to diversity, equity and inclusion in our agency. Viral Nation welcomes applications from people with visible and non-visible disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the recruiting and selection process.

$200k - $240k

Full-time

Flex LTD

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/2602949802589015526?p=1&pos=0&rgn=55157&pageType=7&jobAge=114&jdpSource=101&jdpid=9145583172473086088&crId=US_0US_0)

Flex is building the **AI-native private bank for business owners** .

We’re re-architecting the entire financial system for entrepreneurs—from the first dollar a business earns to how that value compounds, moves, and is ultimately spent in real life. Banking, credit, payments, personal finance, and financial operations—rebuilt from the ground up as a single, intelligent system. **Flex is the full financial home for ambitious owners.**

Since launching publicly in **September 2023** , Flex has scaled from **zero to nine-figure annualized revenue** , with a clear path to **profitability by late 2026** . We move fast, ship relentlessly, and operate with extreme ownership.

Our customers are **affluent business owners ($3–$200M in revenue)**—the backbone of the economy and one of the most underserved segments in finance. They’re stuck with outdated banks and fragmented tools. We’re replacing all of it. The opportunity is massive: a **~$1T+ revenue market** hiding in plain sight. Our ambition is to build a **$100B+ company** by delivering a product that is fundamentally better—not incrementally improved.

Flex has raised $100M+ in equity and $300M+ in debt.

**\- Mission-critical problems** : We build software that directly controls how money moves at scale.

**\- High bar, low ego** : Small teams, exceptional people, real ownership.

**\- Speed over comfort** : We prioritize execution, quality, clarity, and results.

**\- Enduring impact** : What we’re building will define how a generation of owners runs their businesses.

**Team & Locations**

We hire exceptional people who want to build hard things and see their work matter immediately. Roles are available in: San Francisco, Miami, New York, and fully remote.

**Flex Fuels Ambition.**

\\n **About The Role**

Flex is looking for a hands-on Director of Performance Marketing to build and run the engine that brings qualified business owners to Flex, across both self-serve and sales-led motions.

This role is for a performance marketer who has done it before at a fast-growing company and still loves being in the details. You'll own acquisition across our digital growth surfaces, including web, SEO, paid media, creator and emerging channels like Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), and partner closely with Product to turn traffic into activated, revenue-generating customers.

You'll report to the Head of Brand Marketing, manage our agency partners in search and paid media, and help build the team as we grow. It's a high-impact role for someone who thrives on experimentation, understands unit economics, and wants their work to show up in pipeline.

**What You'll Do**

**Growth & Demand Generation**

- Run performance marketing and digital channel execution day to day, and build a small, strong team as the channel mix proves out
- Own paid acquisition across search, display, paid social and retargeting
- Improve CAC, payback period and channel ROI through continuous testing and data-driven iteration
- Partner with Sales and RevOps on ICPs, pipeline goals and campaign planning
- Manage agency partners (SEO/GEO, paid media) to clear goals and timelines
- Own the marketing tech stack, attribution and data flow end to end, building them where they don't exist yet

**Self-Serve & Product-Led Growth**

- Own top-of-funnel acquisition for Flex's self-serve motion
- Partner with Product on activation experiments, onboarding flows and conversion optimization
- Define and report growth KPIs across acquisition, activation and revenue

**Website & Digital Growth Surfaces**

- Treat Flex.one as a core growth surface: discoverability, performance and conversion
- Grow organic acquisition through technical SEO, structured content and site optimization
- Build Flex's visibility across AI discovery platforms such as ChatGPT, Perplexity and Gemini through GEO

**Launches & Content**

- Bring product launches to market with the brand team, with clear messaging and materials for Sales and partners
- Turn Flex's story into high-performing content across the website, campaigns, organic, paid, email and referral channels
- Work closely with Brand, Legal and Compliance so every claim is accurate and every disclosure is in place

**Requirements**

- 8+ years in growth, digital or performance marketing, ideally in fintech or B2B SaaS
- Experience managing people or agency teams, with a track record of building strong ones
- Experience at a company scaling
- Hands-on depth in SEO, paid acquisition, website optimization and modern demand generation
- Comfort with sales-led acquisition, intent-based targeting, personalization and lifecycle triggers
- Strong instincts grounded in research, data and customer insight
- Clear, compelling writing and storytelling
- Technical fluency with modern marketing and analytics tools
- A collaborative, human-first approach, with strong values and a bias toward action

\\n

$200,000 - $240,000 a year

Final compensation within this range will be based on experience, qualifications, and interview performance. This position is also eligible for equity compensation. Flex offers medical, dental and vision insurance, paid time off, and a 401(k) plan. Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

\\n

**Why Join Us**

**Build something generational** — Capture the full lifecycle of money for ambitious business owners.

**Work on real money, real risk** — Payments, credit, and banking at serious scale.

**Solve hard problems** — AI, underwriting, compliance, and global finance from first principles.

**True ownership** — Small teams, high trust, real accountability.

**Founder-level exposure** — Direct access to leadership, customers, and investors.

**High bar, high taste** — Move fast without cutting corners.

**Elite peers** — People here are builders, not tourists.

**Real upside** — Meaningful equity if you help build something big.

Coram-Ai

At Coram AI, we’re reimagining video security for the modern world. Our cloud-native platform uses computer vision and AI to help businesses stay safe, make smarter decisions, and move faster; from real-time alerts to seamless clip sharing and multi-site visibility.

You’ll be joining an ambitious, fast-moving team that values clarity, craftsmanship, and impact. Every person here has a voice, ships meaningful work, and helps shape how AI can make the world safer and more connected.

### The role:

We're hiring a Head of Performance Marketing to own paid acquisition at Coram. Paid sits inside demand gen today, and this role makes it its own function. You'll own the budget, the channels, and the team, and you'll be measured on pipeline and revenue, not clicks.

You'll report to the VP of Marketing and work onsite in Sunnyvale, next to the sales team you're feeding.

### Responsibilities:

- Own paid strategy and budget across Google, Meta, Bing, YouTube, and LinkedIn

- Hit pipeline and CAC targets by channel, and report on them weekly

- Build full-funnel attribution in HubSpot and GA4, from search query to closed-won

- Run landing pages, offers, and conversion testing

- Put spend where our buyers are: facility directors, IT leaders, superintendents, and police chiefs

- Lead and grow the team, starting with two performance marketers plus agencies and freelancers

- Partner with sales and growth engineering on programs that hand warm accounts to SDRs

- Use AI and automation to keep the team lean and fast


### Skills and qualifications:

- 8-12 years in performance or growth marketing, including 3+ years leading the function

- Experience marketing a physical product (security, IoT, robotics, industrial hardware, or similar) to B2B buyers

- Personally scaled paid spend past $15M a year

- Still hands-on in Google Ads, Meta, and LinkedIn

- Able to tie spend to closed revenue in a CRM. HubSpot and GA4 preferred

- Have hired and managed performance marketers

- Daily user of LLMs for analysis, copy, and automation

- Resilient in challenging and fast-paced environments

- Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to influence at all levels

- Ability to work in an onsite environment


### What we offer:

- Competitive compensation package of base, bonus and equity

- 100% Employer-paid medical, dental, vision, and base life insurance

- Flexible paid time off and 10 paid holidays

- 401(k) with both Traditional and Roth options

- Early-stage equity in a rapidly growing company

- Referral bonuses

- Daily team dinners and regular team off-sites

- Free onsite EV charging

- The latest Apple products and unlimited tech stack (Claude Cowork, Nooks, Clay, Instantly, etc.)


We're on a mission to transform a $50B+ legacy industry by bringing the power of cutting-edge multimodal LLMs and computer vision to real-world security and operations. From firearm detection to intelligent access control, our AI-native platform turns every camera and sensor into a smart system that enhances safety, efficiency, and awareness.

Founded by Ashesh Jain (ex-Lyft Level 5, PhD Cornell) and Peter Ondruska (ex-Lyft, PhD Oxford), Coram AI is backed by Ansa Capital, Battery Ventures, Mosaic, 8VC and Up Partners, have raised over $65M, and were named to the CB Insights AI 100 as one of the most promising AI companies in the world. If you're excited to work on mission-critical AI that makes an impact in the real world, we’d love to meet you.

The Head of Performance Marketing will be responsible for developing and executing data-driven strategies that enhance customer acquisition, engagement, and retention. $150k - $200k

Celigo
