##### Director, Brand Marketing

At Celigo, we believe integration should empower — not exhaust — innovation. As a modern Integration and Automation Platform (iPaaS), we're on a mission to simplify how companies integrate, automate, and optimize processes. Powered by game-changing technology like runtime AI and prebuilt, mission-critical integrations, Celigo is redefining how businesses connect their world.

Celigo is looking for a Director of Brand Marketing to own how our brand shows up across the website, content, and creative, building awareness and scaling inbound demand. You will lead a multidisciplinary team spanning content, website, and creative, partner with Product Marketing to bring the company narrative to life, work with Revenue and Partner & Customer Marketing to drive demand through content strategy, and help the executive team elevate the brand through thought leadership. This is a visible, cross-functional leadership role that reports to the Chief Marketing Officer.

What would you do if hired?

- Own how Celigo's brand positioning and narrative come to life across the website, content, campaigns, and customer touchpoints, including the visual and verbal identity system (voice, tone, guidelines, and toolkits) and how it evolves as positioning does.
- Define and track brand awareness metrics (awareness, share of voice, sentiment, brand search volume) and report progress to marketing and executive leadership in terms of the perception and pipeline they move, not the activity behind them.
- Own the website as the most visible expression of Celigo's value proposition for prospects, customers, partners, and stakeholders, and scale it as a growth contributor: aligning on the metrics that matter, diagnosing trends, and running a steady cadence of experiments rather than waiting on one big redesign.
- Own technical SEO strategy, including site architecture, crawlability, indexation, structured data, and Core Web Vitals, so the site stays discoverable and fast.
- Lead Celigo's answer to AI-driven visibility, meaning how AI assistants, generative search, and answer engines surface, summarize, and cite our content. The playbooks here are still being written, so you will form a point of view, test it in market, and adjust as evidence comes in.
- Build and execute a content strategy that drives brand awareness, thought leadership, engagement, SEO, and inbound lead generation, with a clear line from content investment to pipeline impact.
- Oversee content across blog, social, video, email, landing pages, whitepapers, and webinars, partnering with Product Marketing, Revenue Marketing, Partner & Customer Marketing, and Sales so messaging holds up across the full buyer's journey, from first touch to conversion.
- Lead creative ideation and execution for multi-channel campaigns, product launches, brand initiatives, and customer lifecycle marketing, owning the creative vision so every visual and written communication reflects the brand.
- Put AI to work in how this team operates. Use it to scale content and design production, accelerate research and iteration, and absorb the volume work, then apply taste, brand voice, and human judgment on top. Celigo is an AI company, and this team should be visible proof of what that looks like in practice.
- Organize the design team to meet SLAs on day-to-day projects, flex capacity for large-scale work, and make the rest of Marketing faster through templates, tools, and self-serve systems.
- Build, lead, and mentor a high-performing brand, content, and creative team, setting a pace where people ship a strong first version, learn from real signal, and improve it quickly.
- Collaborate across Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and People, and advocate for the power of brand, storytelling, and design inside the company. When you see a gap in how Celigo shows up, you close it rather than route it.

Who are we looking for?

Skills & Abilities

- Exceptional written, verbal, and visual communication skills, with the taste to tell the difference between work that is on brand and work that is merely finished.
- Deep understanding of marketing funnels, audience segmentation, and buyer journeys, and the instinct to ask why a program matters before asking how to run it.
- Knowledge of technical SEO (site architecture, crawlability, structured data, Core Web Vitals) and of how AI-driven and generative search is changing content discovery and visibility.
- Experience with content and design tools (for example Figma, WordPress and other CMS platforms, marketing automation tools) and with SEO, AEO, web analytics, and content analytics platforms (for example SEMrush, Ahrefs, GA4, Google Search Console, AirOps or Peec).
- Energized by applying AI to your own work and your team's, and curious about where it changes how brand, content, and creative get made. Comfortable running experiments before best practices exist.
- A bias toward shipping. You put a thoughtful first version in market, read the real feedback, and make it better, instead of holding work back until it is perfect.
- You treat the company's problems as your own. You measure the team by outcomes such as awareness, traffic, and pipeline rather than volume of output, and you move on things before being asked.
- You build these habits in others. You hire and develop people who are curious, take ownership, and move fast, and you give them enough context to make good calls without you in the room.
- Strong project management skills, comfortable balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution.

Education & Experience

- Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, or a related field.
- 7+ years of experience in brand marketing, content marketing, or creative leadership roles, including experience translating brand positioning and messaging into content, website, and creative execution.
- Proven experience leading teams in a high-growth B2B environment.
- Track record of driving measurable brand awareness and inbound demand growth through website and content programs.

Celigo reasonably expects to pay a base salary between $150,000 and $200,000 per year for this position. Actual starting base pay will be determined by skills, experience, geographic location, and other non-discriminatory factors permitted by law. Total compensation may also include variable incentives, benefits, or other perks as outlined in any formal employment offer made.

Celigo is proud to be

- The #1 ranked iPaaS platform (G2, 8 quarters running)
- A Visionary in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for iPaaS for the second consecutive year
- Ranked #1 iPaaS on G2 for multiple quarters and named a Leader in both B2B/EDI and API Management
- A leading intelligent automation platform that puts the power of automation in the hands of every team, unifying workflows from the predictable to the fully agentic in a single platform.

Here you'll experience

- Remote-first culture, built on trust, collaboration, and transparency
- A high-growth, inclusive work environment where innovation thrives and ideas are implemented
- Lightspeed learning opportunities to keep you at the leading edge of your field
- Exceptional coworkers who challenge and inspire you daily
- Competitive compensation and benefits, including:

 - Three weeks of vacation (starting year one)
 - Wellness days and holidays to recharge
 - Parental leave and a generous benefits package
 - Monthly tech stipend
 - Recognition and career development opportunities

# Director of Affiliate Marketing

Inno Supps

[West Virginia](https://jooble.org/jobs/West-Virginia)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-6920628279714470516?p=1&pos=0&rgn=49&pageType=7&jobAge=234&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-148719815995883580&crId=US_0US_0)

### Job Description

**About the Role**

\\n

Inno Supps is looking for a Director of Affiliate Marketing to own and grow our affiliate and creator programs across TikTok Shop, Instagram, and other affiliate channels.

\\n

\\n

This is a growth and relationship-management role. We’re looking for someone who understands that building a large affiliate roster is only part of the job—the real opportunity is turning creators into active, engaged, revenue-producing partners.

\\n

\\n

You will own the affiliate lifecycle from recruitment and onboarding through activation, engagement, optimization, and retention. You’ll work closely with our social, creative, and performance marketing teams to identify priority products, develop creator opportunities, and build a community that consistently generates content and sales.

\\n

\\n

**What You'll Own**

\\n

Affiliate Recruitment & Growth

\\n

\\n - Build and execute strategies to continuously grow our network of qualified TikTok Shop, Instagram, and other affiliate creators.
\\n - Proactively identify, recruit, and outreach to creators who align with our products, audiences, and brand.
\\n - Develop scalable outreach strategies that improve creator response and acceptance rates.
\\n - Build targeted creator lists based on product, audience, content style, performance potential, and campaign needs.
\\n - Maintain a strong pipeline of prospective, newly onboarded, and active affiliates.
\\n

\\n

Activation & Engagement

\\n

\\n - Own the affiliate journey from **recruited → onboarded → activated → selling → retained** .
\\n - Develop onboarding and activation strategies that encourage new affiliates to create and post quickly.
\\n - Build ongoing communication and engagement strategies through channels such as Discord, email, direct outreach, and TikTok Shop.
\\n - Create educational resources, product information, selling angles, campaign updates, and incentives that help creators produce stronger content.
\\n - Re-engage inactive or underperforming affiliates and identify opportunities to turn promising creators into consistent partners.
\\n - Build strong relationships with top-performing affiliates and identify opportunities to deepen those partnerships.
\\n

\\n

TikTok Shop Affiliate Management

\\n

\\n - Own day-to-day affiliate growth and performance within TikTok Shop.
\\n - Recruit creators through targeted and open collaboration opportunities.
\\n - Manage product seeding, samples, creator communication, commission opportunities, and affiliate campaigns.
\\n - Identify products, offers, and creator/content combinations gaining traction and scale what is working.
\\n - Partner with the broader marketing team around TikTok Shop promotions, launches, GMV initiatives, and paid amplification opportunities.
\\n - Stay current on TikTok Shop affiliate tools, platform changes, creator trends, and emerging growth opportunities.
\\n

\\n

Campaign & Product Strategy

\\n

\\n - Translate company product priorities into clear affiliate campaigns and creator opportunities.
\\n - Match creators with the products and angles most likely to resonate with their audiences.
\\n - Develop affiliate briefs, talking points, product education, and campaign guidance while leaving room for authentic creator-led content.
\\n - Coordinate product launches, promotions, seasonal pushes, and affiliate incentives.
\\n - Identify emerging creator content patterns that can be replicated or scaled across the affiliate network.
\\n

\\n

\\n

What We're Looking For

\\n

\\n - 3+ years of experience in affiliate marketing, creator partnerships, influencer marketing, TikTok Shop, social commerce, or a related growth role.
\\n - Hands-on experience managing an affiliate or creator program with measurable revenue goals.
\\n - Comfortable on camera and able to confidently educate, coach, and provide actionable feedback to creators to improve content and performance.
\\n - Strong understanding of TikTok, short-form creator content, affiliate marketing, and social commerce.
\\n - Experience recruiting, onboarding, activating, and managing creators at scale.
\\n - Comfortable using performance data to make decisions and prioritize opportunities.
\\n - Strong relationship-building and creator communication skills.
\\n - Highly organized and able to manage a large pipeline of creators, campaigns, products, and follow-ups simultaneously.
\\n - Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment where priorities and opportunities can change quickly.
\\n - Strong ownership mentality—you identify problems, recommend solutions, and drive execution rather than waiting for direction.
\\n

\\n

\\n

**Why Inno Supps**

\\n

Inno Supps is a fast-moving health and wellness brand focused on developing products and marketing strategies that stand out in a highly competitive industry.

\\n

\\n

You'll have the opportunity to take real ownership of our affiliate ecosystem and help shape how we recruit creators, build community, launch products, and scale social commerce.

\\n

\\n

We're looking for someone who doesn't just want to manage an affiliate program—we want someone excited to build one that creators want to be part of and that materially contributes to the growth of the business.

\\n

\\n

**Creative Director / Content & Brand Strategist**

**_(Music / Fashion / Social Media)_**

NYC-based artist, model, and content creator is looking for a creative director / brand strategist to help refine and elevate her overall brand presence across music, fashion, and social media.

We’re looking for someone highly creative, trend-aware, and culturally in tune — someone who understands Gen Z internet culture, aesthetics, storytelling, and what makes content feel current, aspirational, and viral.

**Responsibilities include:**

- Helping shape and refine overall brand/image
- Brainstorming and pitching content ideas
- Staying on top of social media trends and viral formats
- Assisting with content planning and execution
- Filming content together in NYC (roughly 1x/week or more depending on schedule)
- Helping create a cohesive visual identity across platforms
- Bringing fresh creative ideas proactively

Most filming/content will likely take place in areas like **_SoHo, Hudson Yards, West Village,_** and other aesthetic neighborhoods around NYC.

**Ideal candidate:**

- Strong understanding of TikTok, Instagram Reels, and Gen Z trends/culture
- Creative, collaborative, organized, and easy to work with
- Has previous work/examples/portfolio to show
- NYC-based preferred
- Experience working with influencers, artists, models, or personal brands is a huge plus

This is a collaborative long-term role for someone excited about helping build a modern artist brand with a strong vision behind it.

**Director of Growth Marketing**

If you love figuring out what makes customers take action, turning ideas into campaigns that generate measurable results, and finding creative ways to grow a business, then we can’t wait to have you join us!

**About You**

We are looking for an experienced, entrepreneurial marketing leader who can take ownership of marketing and growth for an established company serving some of the largest brands and law firms in the world.

If you:

- Are friendly, positive, upbeat, and genuinely enjoy working with others
- Are innovative and naturally look for opportunities to grow a business
- Think about marketing in terms of qualified opportunities and revenue,not simply traffic, impressions, or followers
- Are an exceptional writer who can communicate complicated ideas simply and persuasively
- Love developing campaigns, testing ideas, analyzing results, and figuring out what works
- Can personally create and execute marketing initiatives rather than simply managing others
- Understand B2B marketing and how to market expertise, trust, and professional services
- Are comfortable working directly with a CEO and leadership team
- Bring your own ideas and recommendations rather than waiting to be told what to do
- Move quickly, experiment, and learn from results
- Want to build something significant and take on increasing responsibility over time

…then you may be the ideal candidate for our team.

**About Marksmen**

Marksmen (www.marksmen.com) is a rare and unique company. We provide brand protection for the largest companies in the world. Famous companies whose products you own and services you use every day trust us to confidentially investigate, research, and acquire trademarks, domain names, and social media handles on their behalf. We also track down counterfeiters who are making and selling unauthorized goods.

Over 2 billion people actively use trademarks and domain names we have secured for clients. Our work is exceptional, and we are consistently recognized as a leading brand protection firm in the world. Our employees are also exceptional, and we can’t wait to have another world-class professional join our team. We hope it’s you!

**About the Position: Director of Growth Marketing**

We are looking for an experienced, hands-on marketing leader to take ownership of Marksmen’s marketing and growth.Your primary responsibility is simple:

- **Help Marksmen generate more qualified business opportunities and revenue.**

This role requires someone who can both develop strategy and execute it. You will create campaigns, write copy, develop offers, analyze results, use marketing technology, and ensure initiatives actually get launched.

We want someone constantly asking: **What is working? What is generating opportunities and revenue? What should we test next?**

This position reports directly to the CEO and will have significant influence on the company’s growth.

This is a full-time position (40 hours/week) working from our Alpine, Utah office. Work hours are 8 am to 5 pm with a one-hour lunch break.

**Key Responsibilities**

- Develop and execute Marksmen’s marketing and growth strategy, focused on generating qualified opportunities, pipeline, and revenue
- Create compelling campaigns, positioning, messaging, offers, and content for our target audiences
- Grow existing client relationships through cross-selling, reactivation, and targeted marketing programs
- Turn Marksmen’s expertise, case history, and data into effective thought leadership and marketing
- Develop and launch campaigns for new services, continually testing messaging, audiences, and channels
- Manage CRM, marketing automation, outside resources, and performance metrics
- Proactively identify growth opportunities, bring ideas to leadership, and take ownership of marketing results

**What Success Looks Like**

- Create visible momentum quickly.
- Within your first several months, understand our customers and services, identify the highest-potential growth opportunities, launch targeted campaigns, improve existing- and former-client marketing, and establish clear performance metrics.
- Generate measurable engagement and qualified opportunities, with growing pipeline as campaigns gain traction.
- Most importantly, become the person bringing growth ideas to the company rather than waiting for the company to bring marketing ideas to you.

**Required Experience & Skills**

- Bachelor’s degree and 7+ years of professional marketing experience, including significant B2B experience
- Demonstrated success generating qualified leads, pipeline, or revenue through marketing
- Experience marketing professional services or another sophisticated B2B offering strongly preferred
- Exceptional copywriting, communication, and campaign-development skills
- Strong understanding of demand generation, CRM, email, content, digital marketing, automation, segmentation, and AI tools
- Ability to use data to measure performance, improve results, and make sound business decisions
- Proven ability to independently identify opportunities, take initiative, manage multiple priorities, and work directly with senior leadership
- Ability to move quickly without sacrificing quality or attention to detail. Please include the word Arrow in your cover letter.
- A demonstrated commitment to Marksmen’s core values: Relentless, Quick, Innovative, Meticulous, Dependable, and Friendly

**What We Want to See**

We care more about what you have actually accomplished than impressive marketing terminology.

- Strong candidates should be prepared to provide examples of:
- Marketing campaigns you personally developed and executed
- Messaging or copy you personally created
- Qualified opportunities, pipeline, or revenue your marketing generated
- New services, products, or programs you successfully helped launch
- Campaigns that did not initially work and how you improved them
- Growth opportunities you identified and successfully pursued
- Be prepared to clearly explain **your personal contribution and the measurable results you produced.**

**Our Benefits**

We value and appreciate our employees. Here’s what we provide:

- Medical, dental, and vision insurance with personal and family options
- 26 days of PTO per year, including 11 paid holidays and 15 paid days off, increasing over time
- 100% matching 401(k) contributions up to 6%
- Monthly gym membership reimbursement
- Paid Spotify or Apple Music account
- Free food and snacks in our kitchens
- Optional monthly off-site team activities
- The stability of an established company combined with the opportunities and momentum of a growing organization

**About Defuse Labs**
**Defuse Labs builds NEAR Intents, the universal transaction layer for the AI economy — intent-based infrastructure that enables people, agents, and applications to move value across chains and assets without bridges, fragmented liquidity, or manual routing.**

**At the center of our product ecosystem is **near.com** .**
**near.com is building a permissionless financial account: one place to hold, grow, invest, trade and use assets across blockchains, with privacy and control at its core. Our ambition is to make sophisticated financial capabilities feel like parts of one coherent product, increasingly accessible through conversation and trusted agents.**
**Our initial customers are comfortable with crypto and value their time, privacy and independence. They want access to what financial technology makes possible without having to manage its complexity.**

**We also build **NEAR Intents** , the universal transaction layer for the AI economy — intent-based infrastructure that enables people, agents, and applications to move value across chains and assets without bridges, fragmented liquidity, or manual routing. Instead of specifying a transaction path, users simply express what they want to achieve, and a competitive network of solvers fulfills the intent with competitive execution across available liquidity.**
**_We operate in startup mode: high ownership, fast execution, and high standards. We’re a small, globally distributed team that moves quickly, takes initiative, and adapts as the product and market evolve._ About the Role**
**We’re hiring a **Head of Product Marketing & Growth (Lead)** with a primary focus on **near.com** — owning how the product is positioned, understood, launched, and adopted by users.**

**This is a foundational, highly product-oriented role responsible for **how near.com is understood, brought to market, and adopted by users** . You’ll develop a deep understanding of our users and market, define the product’s positioning, target audiences and core use cases, and own go-to-market across launches and the broader product lifecycle.**

**You’ll work closely with Product and Growth to turn that understanding into adoption — shaping onboarding, messaging, distribution and product education, and identifying the barriers that prevent users from discovering value and coming back. You’ll combine qualitative customer insight with product data to understand what resonates, where users drop off, and what could improve acquisition, activation, engagement and retention.**

**This is not a role that simply markets what Product has already built. You’ll bring the market and user perspective into product decisions, helping us determine **who we are building for, which use cases matter most, how the product should evolve, and how we take it to market** .**

**You’ll also support product marketing for **NEAR Intents** , particularly around partner positioning, integrations, and launches with CEXs, wallets, fintech platforms, and other distribution partners.**

**You’ll be particularly effective in this role if you’ve worked and grew the consumer product organization at a CEX, fintech company, neo-banks, wallet, trading platform, payments product, or another digital-asset business. You understand how users discover and evaluate financial or crypto products, what creates trust and friction, and how product experience, positioning, onboarding and distribution work together to drive adoption.**
**Key Responsibilities**

**- Own **end-to-end product marketing for near.com** — positioning, messaging, go-to-market, launches, and adoption.**
**- Define and continuously refine **target audiences, core use cases, value proposition, and competitive positioning** based on user, product, and market insights.**
**- Act as **the voice of the user** , translating research, feedback, and behavioral data into actionable Product and UX recommendations.**
**- Partner with Product and Growth to improve **acquisition, onboarding, activation, engagement, and retention** , identifying and addressing key adoption barriers.**
**- Lead go-to-market for new features and releases, including launch strategy, messaging, distribution, and success metrics.**
**- Own product-facing communications and enablement, including website messaging, onboarding, launch materials, FAQs, decks, and product education.**
**- Support **NEAR Intents product marketing and partner launches** , working with BD on positioning, partner materials, co-marketing, and post-launch adoption.**
**- Build repeatable product marketing processes and playbooks that make launches, experimentation, and adoption initiatives more scalable.**

**Requirements**

**- 4–7 years of experience in product marketing or a closely related product role, ideally with meaningful experience at a centralized exchange, fintech company, crypto wallet, or another trading, payments, or digital-asset product.**
**- A proven track record of owning go-to-market for product features or integrations end-to-end — from positioning and launch through to adoption and performance tracking, not just creative execution.**
**- Strong understanding of exchange, wallet, or fintech users and product teams — you understand how they evaluate infrastructure, what creates friction or drives adoption, and how to translate those insights into better product and messaging decisions.**
**- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to turn technical or ambiguous concepts into clear, compelling narratives for both partner teams and end users.**

# Director of Growth Marketing

Location:USCompany:Milk Makeup

## Description:

**Welcome to the MILK MAKEUP FAM:**

At Milk Makeup, we’re all about cool clean beauty fueled by creativity. Born out of Milk, a creative hub in downtown New York City, innovation, self-expression, and community are at the heart of everything we do. We believe beauty isn’t about how you do your makeup, it’s what you do in it—and how you Live Your Look—that matters.

**Who YOU are:**

• **Community connector**: You’re always thinking about how to improve your and your community’s future. You’re passionate about building a global community where everyone can feel seen and inspired in beauty.

• **Courageous but chill:** Wherever you come from, you’re driven by the hardworking New York spirit that Milk embodies. You’re flexible and ready to get the job done, but you’re humble and make moves thoughtfully. You strive for quality, have fun doing it, and always have the greater good of the brand in mind.

• **Fearlessly innovative:** You’re not afraid to take calculated risks and enjoy problem solving. You’re down to disrupt the status quo and innovate in order to raise the bar. You value a forward-thinking space that encourages you to lead change, never follow.

• **Champion of self-expression:** You’re creative at heart and are always genuinely _you_. You live your look and want to grow with people who celebrate individuality.

• **Inclusive + mindful:** You believe an open mind is always the best place to start and value active listening. You embrace differences and help foster a safe working environment for yourself and your peers.

**The ROLE:**

The Director of Growth Marketing will spearhead the strategy and execution of all growth marketing initiatives, driving aggressive expansion across DTC, retailer e-commerce, and TikTok Shop channels. This role necessitates a full-funnel perspective, aligning objectives with the 5 key marketing pillars and assuming ownership of the entire paid media landscape. Reporting directly to the VP of Digital and Growth, this role will serve as a pivotal strategic partner to the VP — translating vision into execution, bringing forward data-driven recommendations, and acting as a trusted thought partner on the direction of the growth marketing function. They will play a pivotal role in identifying and implementing innovative growth strategies, harnessing data-driven insights to optimize acquisition, activation, retention, and revenue.

**What YOU'll do:**

**Strategic Leadership:**

- Report directly to the VP of Digital and Growth, serving as a key strategic partner — closely aligning on growth priorities, bringing data-backed points of view to the table, and helping shape the broader digital and growth roadmap.
- Lead the development and execution of a comprehensive growth marketing strategy, aligning with overall business objectives and driving aggressive growth in DTC, e-commerce, and TikTok Shop channels.
- Oversee and mentor the Growth Marketing Manager and E-commerce Manager, ensuring clear communication, goal alignment, and professional development across both functions.
- Identify and implement innovative growth strategies, staying ahead of industry trends and best practices.
- Review and approve key growth marketing strategies, performance analysis reports, and cross-functional collaboration plans, ensuring data-driven strategic innovation, optimization, and holistic campaign leadership aligned with overall business objectives and the MMU DNA.
- Conduct regular performance reviews, offer constructive feedback, and actively engage in the development of direct reports in line with the company's performance engagement expectations.
- Embody and champion the behavioral values outlined in the MMU DNA, fostering a positive and inclusive team culture that reflects the company's core principles.

**Campaign Execution & Optimization**

- Own and manage all paid social and paid search activity end-to-end — strategy, execution, budget, and performance — across large-scale social awareness, PPM, and PPC campaigns, collaborating with organic social, e-commerce, influencer, and external agency teams.
- Own paid and organic strategy for TikTok Shop, partnering with e-commerce and social teams to drive product discovery, conversion, and revenue through the platform.
- Develop audience segmentation strategy by media platform, tailoring targeting, messaging, and creative approach to the unique audience behaviors and best practices of each channel.
- Manage creative optimization and creative testing for all paid social assets, partnering closely with the Creative team to build and maintain a consistent testing cadence, iterate based on performance signals, and translate learnings into sharper creative briefs.

## Description:

**Marketing Director – Brand Growth & Market Leadership**

_Are you a marketing leader who thrives on building brands, driving customer engagement, and creating campaigns that deliver measurable results? Do you have the ability to develop innovative marketing strategies while navigating the complexities of a highly regulated cannabis market? If you're driven by creativity, accountability, and growth, this role is for you._

Mitten Extracts is seeking a strategic and results-driven Marketing Director to lead the company's marketing, brand development, product marketing, and digital marketing initiatives across the organization, including wholesale brands, retail dispensaries, product launches, and consumer-facing campaigns.

This role is responsible for driving brand awareness, customer acquisition, retention, and revenue growth while ensuring all marketing activities align with business objectives, compliance requirements, and evolving consumer trends. The Marketing Director will work closely with the Community Director to ensure alignment between marketing strategies, community engagement efforts, partnerships, and brand messaging. This position will play a critical role in strengthening Mitten Extracts' market position and building scalable marketing strategies to support continued growth throughout Michigan and future markets.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Marketing Strategy & Brand Leadership**

• Develop and execute the company's overall marketing strategy across retail, wholesale, and product categories

• Establish annual marketing plans, budgets, KPIs, and growth initiatives

• Identify opportunities to increase market share, brand awareness, and customer loyalty

• Lead long-term brand strategy while maintaining consistency across all channels

**2\. Brand Management & Consumer Engagement**

• Oversee all brand positioning, messaging, and visual identity initiatives across the organization.

• Develop and manage the annual marketing budget, ensuring alignment with company growth objectives and approved spending parameters.

• Monitor budget utilization monthly and reallocate resources as needed to maximize marketing effectiveness and ROI.

• Ensure marketing investments deliver measurable business outcomes and remain within approved budget thresholds.

• Ensure consistency across packaging, retail environments, digital channels, social media, and promotional materials.

• Develop consumer engagement programs and loyalty initiatives that strengthen brand awarenes, customer retention, and long-term loyalty.

• Conduct market research, competitive analysis, and consumer insights evaluations to inform brand strategy and business decisions.

• Collaborate closely with the Community Director to align marketing campaigns, community engagement efforts, events, partnerships, and outreach initiatives with the company's vision, values, and strategic objectives.

**3\. Product Marketing & Launch Execution**

• Partner with Sales, Production, Compliance, and Product Development teams to execute successful product launches

• Develop go-to-market strategies for new products and categories

• Lead product positioning, messaging, pricing support, and promotional planning

• Analyze product performance and recommend portfolio optimization opportunities

**4\. Digital Marketing & Customer Acquisition**

• Oversee digital marketing strategy, including website, SEO, email, SMS, social media, and paid advertising

• Ensure compliance with all cannabis advertising regulations and platform requirements

• Optimize customer acquisition costs and return on marketing investment

• Leverage analytics and performance data to continuously improve campaign effectiveness

• Build dashboards and reporting tools to track marketing performance

• Monitor KPIs including:

- Brand awareness
- Customer acquisition
- Customer retention
- Retail traffic
- Campaign ROI
- Revenue contribution
- Market share growth
- Marketing spend versus budget
- Customer acquisition cost (CAC)
- Return on advertising spend (ROAS)
- Cost per lead and cost per conversion
- Budget efficiency and campaign profitability

• Present performance results and recommendations to executive leadership

**6\. Cross-Functional Leadership**

• Partner with:

- Sales (trade marketing, wholesale growth, customer engagement)
- Operations & Production (product launches, inventory planning)
- Finance (budget management, ROI analysis)
- HR (employer branding and recruiting support)

• Ensure alignment between marketing strategy and business objectives

**7\. Team Leadership & Culture**

• Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing marketing organization

• Manage internal marketing personnel, agencies, designers, and external partners

• Foster a culture of accountability, creativity, innovation, and continuous improvement

• Promote company values: #Vision #Iron #Build

**Qualifications**

**Required**

• 7+ years of progressive marketing leadership experience

• 3+ years of marketing leadership experience within the cannabis industry

• Proven success building and growing consumer brands

• Experience managing multi-channel marketing campaigns and budgets

• Strong understanding of retail marketing, product launches, customer acquisition, and brand strategy

• Experience analyzing marketing performance and translating data into actionable business decisions

• Executive presence with the ability to influence leadership and cross-functional teams

**Preferred (Highly Desired)**

• Experience in cannabis, CPG, beverage, alcohol, or other highly regulated industries

• Deep understanding of:

- Cannabis compliance and advertising restrictions
- Retail dispensary operations
- Wholesale cannabis sales channels
- Consumer packaged goods (CPG) marketing

• Experience with loyalty platforms, CRM systems, digital advertising, SEO, and marketing automation tools

• Experience launching and scaling multiple cannabis brands

**Key Competencies**

• Strategic Thinking & Execution

• Brand Building & Consumer Engagement

• Marketing Analytics & ROI Management

• Digital Marketing Expertise

• Product & Market Insight

• Leadership & Team Development

• Cross-Functional Influence

• Adaptability in a Regulated Environment

**Success Metrics (First 12 Months)**

• Increase brand awareness and customer engagement across all channels.

• Improve customer acquisition and retention metrics.

• Successfully launch and scale new product initiatives.

• Increase retail traffic and loyalty program participation.

• Improve marketing ROI and campaign effectiveness.

• Strengthen wholesale and retail brand presence throughout Michigan.

• Build a scalable and accountable marketing organization.

• Maintain annual marketing spend within ±5% of approved budget.

• Achieve target ROAS and customer acquisition cost goals established by executive leadership.

• Deliver quarterly marketing ROI and budget performance reviews to executive leadership.

• Demonstrate measurable revenue impact from major marketing campaigns and product launches.

# Associate Director of Growth Marketing

Location:USCompany:Good Moose

## Description:

Good Moose is an independent boutique Growth Marketing Agency based in New York, partnering with brands of all growth stages, from startups to established market leaders. We help brands to launch, grow, and scale sustainably.

Our team combines hands-on media platform experience with high expertise across creative, analytics, and retention. We leverage data to feed all our processes through measurement, automation, segmentation, attribution, and incrementally, feeding thoughtful, powerful, and efficient strategies that help brands to grow in a profitable way.

In this remote-first role, you'll be a part of a growing media team that primarily focuses on driving conversions and revenue, but also helps define a full-funnel marketing approach as needed for various clients. In this position, you will gain unparalleled exposure to the entire brand process, from pre-launch to scaling, and build extensive knowledge of best practices in the media industry. We are a dedicated team, passionate about the work we do, how we do it, and who we do it for, and we are looking for an Associate Director of Growth Marketing to work and grow with us.

Responsibilities:

- **Team Leadership & Oversight**: Oversee team members on their various accounts, supporting them and facilitating their development. In this role, you will serve as the escalation point and oversight of day-to-day operations for client teams. There is potential for the associate director to grow and develop into a position on the management team in the future.
- **Client Relationship Development:** Grow relationships with existing clients through partnership and support across their growth strategy. You understand how to support brand partners and build relationships with them. In this role, you will have the opportunity to work directly with brand senior leadership - from Investors to Board Members and CEOs - to help identify and build their brands. This includes supporting them through growth stages.
- **Digital Media Management & Execution:** Lead, oversee and support best-in-class media planning, campaign setups, optimizations, reporting, and analysis focusing on improving Direct Response results across search, social, and display platforms for specific clients. Strength in both paid social and paid search would definitely come in handy, but we can support training if your expertise is geared more heavily towards one over the other. The goal is for you to have a holistic understanding of paid media channels and their effects on one another across the funnel.
- **Growth-Minded Outlook:** Going beyond the day-to-day paid media to truly understand everything that contributes to and leads to sales and growth is important in this role. You work with brand teams to understand their growth goals. You learn to look at the landscape, consumers, data, landing pages, creative, apps, pricing structures, etc. and brainstorm ways to further reduce friction in the customer journey and help to grow brands.

Qualifications:

- 5+ years experience leading performance media teams and accounts, in a heavily client-facing role
- Experience managing client communications and external relationships
- Expertise in paid social and/or paid search management, with a truly holistic understanding of the marketing funnel and the role of both in it (highly preferred if you have experience with other channels too: CTV/OTT, programmatic, OOH, etc.)
- Experience overseeing other team members - training and fostering their growth
- Ability to think outside the box
- Understanding of how to pivot and shift depending on KPIs and business goals (not just media goals)
- Digital media planning and buying management experience
- Exceptional presentation and communication skills
- Ability to read and understand data, and to visualize it effectively
- Strong direct-response background driving relevant business results for clients and a thorough understanding of best-in-class practices in these tactics
- Exceptional attention to detail, organizational skills, and time management capabilities
- Other Relevant Tools Experience: Google Drive (Sheets, Slides, etc.), Microsoft Excel, etc.
- Bonus: Knowledge of startups. Understanding of Shopify, Google Data Studio, Tableau, Rockerbox, Glew, Looker, etc.

Flex Fridays

401K Retirement Plan with Company Match

Commuter Benefits

Dependent Care FSA

Mental Health - TalkSpace Membership

# Creative Assistant Marketing Director

Location:Jupiter, FLCompany:The Club at Admirals Cove

## Description:

**Pay:** From $100,000.00 per year

Job Summary

We are seeking a dynamic and strategic Assistant Director of Communications & Marketing to lead our organization’s communication efforts and elevate our brand presence. This energetic role involves developing innovative marketing campaigns, managing media relations, overseeing content creation, and ensuring consistent messaging across all channels. The ideal candidate will possess a passion for storytelling, exceptional communication skills, and a keen eye for detail. By driving strategic initiatives, you will help amplify our mission, engage diverse audiences, and strengthen our reputation.

This is an onsite, hands-on creative leadership position. The Assistant Director must independently produce high-quality designs while coordinating daily departmental operations, supporting creative staff, and meeting deadlines. Advanced Adobe InDesign proficiency, strong graphic design and print production skills, and demonstrated team leadership are essential. Design Portfolio Required: Applicants must submit a professional portfolio demonstrating work they personally designed. Summary The Assistant Director of Marketing & Communications supports the Director of Marketing & Communications in the execution and oversight of the Club’s marketing and communications strategies. This position helps lead day-to-day department operations and ensures timely, accurate, and consistent communications across print, digital, email, website, social media, and Club platforms. Works closely with Club leadership and departments to develop effective communications, maintain brand standards, manage projects and deadlines, and support a high level of member satisfaction. Assumes departmental leadership responsibilities in the Director’s absence.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities include the following:

● Assists the Director of Marketing & Communications in managing daily department operations, staff assignments, workloads, project priorities, production schedules, and deadlines.

● Provides direction, training, and quality oversight to departmental staff and assumes responsibility for daily operations in the Director's absence.

● Personally designs and produces high-quality Club collateral, including flyers, menus, brochures, newsletters, calendars, invitations, signage, and digital graphics using Adobe InDesign, Photoshop, and Illustrator.

● Maintains consistent Club branding, messaging, typography, visual standards, and editorial quality across all print and digital communications.

● Coordinates marketing and creative requests from Golf, Racquets, Wellness, Fitness, Food & Beverage. Plans, coordinates, edits, and distributes recurring member emails, employee newsletters, promotional campaigns, and other Club communications, including content collection, audience targeting, approvals, and scheduling.

● Assists with the development and production of the Club magazine, Member Directory, annual calendar, and other publications, coordinating content, revisions, printing, and distribution.

● Maintains and updates the Club website, online event calendar, social media platforms, mobile applications, and digital displays, ensuring timely and accurate information.

● Ensures all creative materials are properly sized, formatted, proofread, and exported for print, email, social media, and Android digital displays.

● Coordinates photography and videography for Club events, publications, and marketing initiatives, including shot lists, vendor scheduling, content production, and digital asset management.

● Oversees project tracking, production timelines, approval processes, and final quality checks to ensure accurate, publication-ready materials are delivered on schedule.

● Maintains departmental Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), vendor contacts, design templates, production files, ordering instructions, and documented workflows.

● Coordinates with printers, photographers, videographers, and other vendors; obtains estimates and assists with purchasing, supply inventory, invoice tracking, expense management, and budget monitoring.

● Assists members with communication-related questions, including email subscriptions, website access, and member app issues, coordinating technical support when necessary.

● Supports the Director with departmental planning, leadership presentations, reporting, award submissions, special initiatives, and other strategic projects.

● Provides on-site support for Club events, photography, video production, and marketing activities, including occasional evenings, weekends, and holidays as required.

● Communicates professionally and courteously with members, employees, management, vendors, and the general public.

● Complies with all Club policies, procedures, and applicable regulations while maintaining a professional demeanor that reflects positively on The Club at Admirals Cove.

● Performs other duties and special projects as assigned by the Director of Marketing & Communications.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

● Strong marketing, communications, writing, editing, and proofreading skills.

● Demonstrated leadership and project management skills, including the ability to prioritize assignments, coordinate multiple deadlines, and provide direction to staff.

● Strong understanding of brand standards and the ability to maintain consistency across print and digital communications.

● Ability to multi-task, exercise sound judgment, and work effectively in a fast-paced environment with competing priorities.

Proficiency in Adobe InDesign, Photoshop, and Illustrator.

● Excellent graphic design, typography, publication layout, print production, writing, editing, and proofreading skills.

● Demonstrated creative team leadership, project management, organization, and ability to meet simultaneous deadlines.

● Knowledge of digital marketing, email platforms, website content, social media, photography, and video production. Familiarity with Jonas Club Software and private club technology systems preferred.

● Strong interpersonal skills and professional judgment when working with Members, leadership, staff, and vendors.

● Understanding of copyright, multimedia usage rights, confidentiality, and Club brand standards.

Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, graphic design, journalism, or a related field preferred. Three to five years of progressively responsible experience in marketing, communications, or creative production, including project coordination or team leadership. Familiarity with private club operations, member communications, and service standards strongly preferred; prior private club or luxury hospitality experience preferred. Equivalent combinations of education and experience may be considered.

Computer Skills:

Proficiency in Adobe InDesign, Photoshop, Illustrator, Microsoft Office, digital publishing, email marketing, content management systems, social media tools, digital signage, and project management software. Familiarity with Jonas Club Software, including member information, Club communications, and related workflows, strongly preferred.

- 401(k) matching
- Dental insurance
- Employee assistance program
- Employee discount
- Flexible spending account
- Health insurance
- Life insurance
- Paid time off
- Referral program
- Vision insurance

We are seeking a **Medical Assistant** to join our team! As a Medical Assistant, you will be preparing for each patient visit by preparing charts and pulling notes before their arrival, providing routine support alongside nurses and medical staff, and assisting with keeping track of tests and lab reporting to ensure everything arrives on time and the patient is kept informed on their condition and care. You will also be helping manage the inventory of medical supplies, setting up machines and testing equipment, and cleaning instruments and rooms as needed. The ideal candidate has strong customer service skills, an interest in learning more about a working medical environment, and has previous office experience.

**Responsibilities**

- Prepare for the patient visit, including pulling charts and notes, as well as setting up medical equipment
- Clean instruments and equipment after use
- Answer phones and field questions about medical issues, identifying visit needs
- Assist nurses and doctors with basic medical care and procedures
- Track lab results, call in prescriptions, and handle basic medical office duties

**Qualifications**

- BLS Certification or Certified Medical Assistant desired
- Excellent customer service skills
- Strong attention to detail
